clean_body: | | | | | My meeting with President Trump | Yesterday, I had the distinct pleasure of visit with President Donald Trump. President Trump and I sat and discussed how important family issues are to voters, and I shared with him our 2024 Families First Campaign Plan. And trust me when I tell you that Donald Trump has made it very clear he wants to prioritize empowering families and protecting American children. We had a great conversation and a good laugh. Like every other political organization in the country, we've been preparing for a showdown between Joe Biden and Donald Trump, but we knew there was always a good chance they would replace him. The laugh was because our team is currently refreshing our campaign materials and ads for, as President Trump calls her, "laughing Kamala." But don't be fooled: Kamala Harris is still a serious threat to American families. Over the next few weeks, our team will be providing crucial information to you on who Kamala Harris really is, how she threatens American families, and the stark contrast between her and President Trump. In the coming days, APP PAC will launch our $18 million 'Every Family Votes' campaign to reach millions of families in battleground states to win back the White House, retake the Senate, and grow our majority in the House. This is a massive moment. I can't recall a time in my political career where we've had to execute a complete reset during an election year. Defining Kamala Harris and showing voters the clear differences between her and Donald Trump is imperative to winning big in November! As I was leaving the meeting, I shared one final thought with President Trump. | "Mr. President, you've had our back. Now we have yours." Let's go win this thing! Thank you, Terry Schilling President American Principles Project | Thank you for standing with us in the fight for America's families. Politics is full of universal truths, axioms, and unquestioned orthodoxy. We're here to take a closer look at some of that.
Welcome to **Not Quite Right ...** Where we break down where unchallenged assumptions are wrong.
* * *
# [Cori Bush is a uniquely bad member of Congress](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=2440398&post_id=146720176&utm_source=post-email-title&utm_campaign=email-post-title&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MTQ2NzIwMTc2LCJpYXQiOjE3MjE4MzQwNDUsImV4cCI6MTcyNDQyNjA0NSwiaXNzIjoicHViLTI0NDAzOTgiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.HeXhYrH0k5QwRTFWkVVFC9Ruz9NtRvBG-5buVXV3S08)
### You should vote against her if you can. She has no legislative accomplishments, brings nothing to the region, and other than lining her own pockets, has nothing to show for four years in Congress.
| | [Ben Samuels](https://substack.com/@bensamuels)

| | | [](https://substack.com/redirect/2/eyJlIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9vcGVuLnN1YnN0YWNrLmNvbS9wdWIvYmVuc2FtdWVscy9wL2NvcmktYnVzaC1pcy1hLXVuaXF1ZWx5LWJhZC1tZW1iZXI_.CKvRAT98RoSskUWyqMDAtsNsqN-2G7khpmt2Sn1806Y?&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email)
---
| | [READ IN APP](https://open.substack.com/pub/bensamuels/p/cori-bush-is-a-uniquely-bad-member?utm_source=email&redirect=app-store)
---
A few weeks ago, I wrote that [in states like Arkansas, Indiana, and Missouri, Democrats should vote in Republican primaries](https://substack.com/redirect/390113d2-8f37-44ec-8e7a-4773b2f33802?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), since the Republicans who come out of those elections will [almost certainly win in November](https://substack.com/redirect/bcab1a55-9dd3-46f9-85b5-e2b4aff9b4b8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
That's a sound strategy when the highest impact you can have is voting for your statewide officials. But even that is **Not Quite Right ...** What I meant to say, really, is that you should vote on the primary ballot where your most _important_ elections are happening.
Usually, those are your statewide elections. But not always.
On Tuesday, August 6, those of you who live in [Missouri's First Congressional District](https://substack.com/redirect/8def8cc8-bf1b-480b-8d81-b40ff9202adb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) (MO-1) will have the opportunity to vote Cori Bush out of office. **You should. 1**
**Cori Bush is a uniquely bad and ineffective member of Congress**. I'll explain why, and why those of you who have a chance to [vote for Democrat Wesley Bell](https://substack.com/redirect/05f700cf-9b53-432b-94ed-4cb10592bcb9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) should do so.
[Subscribe now](https://substack.com/redirect/22400150-d038-4e6f-99c1-d1956e840298?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
For those of you who live elsewhere in Missouri (or don't live in Missouri at all), you will see parallels with what's going on in other parts of the country. People are tired of performative politics, an unwillingness to compromise, and prioritizing ideology over their constituents.
Cori Bush does all of that.
### **The most effective members of Congress understand the importance of local issues. Cori Bush ignores them**
As the saying goes, all politics is local. When you look at the most effective legislators in Congress, and why candidates win in some of the country's toughest races, it's because they focus on local issues.2
On the other end of the spectrum are the ineffective legislators who do nothing for their communities. That's Cori Bush.
Cori Bush was [one of only six Democrats](https://substack.com/redirect/28efb11a-15dd-4724-a620-51f696a9649d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) who partnered with 200 Republicans to vote against the [Infrastructure Investment and Jobs Act](https://substack.com/redirect/2ecab0d8-3275-4557-87d2-b75de6e75cf3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Anyone who has driven in St. Louis lately understands [how bad the roads are](https://substack.com/redirect/44ec0ea1-0b85-40d7-b960-b3433a486f9d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), and how desperately we needed that investment.
Of course, none of this has stopped Cori Bush from misleading voters by claiming credit for projects where she deserves none. She [showed up to an event to take a victory lap for investments from the infrastructure bill](https://substack.com/redirect/59fc2726-863c-4a2f-86d9-cb46dc2f4c48?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) despite having voted against it.
But that's hardly her only anti-St. Louis vote. [Boeing is the second-largest private employer in the region](https://substack.com/redirect/4c9a3c4c-502b-47da-962a-37cae78fc2d7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), employing nearly 17,000 St. Louisans. Nearby Scott Air Force Base employs another 13,000. So voting to make sure that critical defense jobs remain in greater St. Louis feels like a no brainer, right?
Nope, not for Cori Bush, who's repeatedly [voted against defense spending](https://substack.com/redirect/bbff3884-d715-44df-947e-abb5bf990ae2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
### **Defund the Police for thee, not for me**
Violence is the biggest issue facing St. Louis, which has America's [highest violent crime rate](https://substack.com/redirect/cac0a2e4-78e4-4971-b285-dfcfda187097?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). The homicide rate is [16x higher than the national average](https://substack.com/redirect/693a5b82-258f-41f8-ad54-d8574059b4cf?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), and the scourge of violence is [particularly acute for the Black community](https://substack.com/redirect/cb139c00-9fbd-4f1f-8e60-5f5c99f99d69?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
There is not an overnight fix. But St. Louis needs someone serious about taking incremental steps to address crime and violence. **Cori Bush is doing none of that.**
Despite the fact that Defund the Police [was never effective](https://substack.com/redirect/4a63245c-fa43-4771-9f0a-f61d465887c0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), is [wildly unpopular ](https://substack.com/redirect/9cc0785a-026d-4779-8f2f-72fe292e14e4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), and is [overwhelmingly unpopular with Black voters](https://substack.com/redirect/c31070aa-724d-4bdb-8fea-2d39a43ed8f1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), Cori Bush stubbornly continues to support the cause. She [did in 2022](https://substack.com/redirect/c8c9ee4a-2d25-4c5f-81c9-1869b2aeb193?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), and [she's not backing away in 2024](https://substack.com/redirect/1e8599cb-4ee6-4eeb-b012-e9711ad3a10b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
But here's the kicker: Bush spends [more on private security](https://substack.com/redirect/ab80249a-dd9f-4e2a-aed9-2899320ceb7f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) than just about any other member of Congress, having spent [close to $500,000 on private security](https://substack.com/redirect/9d13756a-5df5-4457-a7f6-a6f278628360?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in the 2022 cycle. Just to be clear, this is highly aberrant. Combined, the rest of Missouri's House delegation has spent a [grand total of $0 on private security](https://substack.com/redirect/76c7b2f0-02a1-4a8d-891e-852dad4c833f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
When asked about this, she gave a [dismissive, rude, and tone-deaf answer](https://substack.com/redirect/6a558988-09af-4bd5-ae17-cddba768cf37?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg):
> So if I end up spending $200,000, if I spend 10, 10, 10 more dollars on it, you know what, I get to be here to do the work. **So suck it up and defunding the police has to happen.** We need to defund the police...
Let's be clear: political violence is a huge issue in this country. We saw that on full display in Pennsylvania with the recent near-assassination of Donald Trump. We _should_ be spending more on safety for our elected officials.
But to spend lavishly relative to your peers on private security, while pushing to defund the police, is an act of supreme entitlement--it means you think you deserve more safety than the people you represent.
Doing so when you represent the most dangerous city in America? That's a moral outrage.
### With a national platform, she fails to take even basic steps to help St. Louisans
After a [high-profile protest](https://substack.com/redirect/65a69065-fdd0-4043-940f-eede49eeb709?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in 2021, [fawning](https://substack.com/redirect/86af44c2-066f-4417-85e6-c5c9f31b73ff?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) [press](https://substack.com/redirect/4774fab4-e54f-400a-b5d3-333a04f92d20?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) [from](https://substack.com/redirect/4774fab4-e54f-400a-b5d3-333a04f92d20?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) [national](https://substack.com/redirect/49df244d-97e4-470b-998e-063fdebc44d0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) [media](https://substack.com/redirect/3171e0bd-3e9c-478e-9728-8c570e43bb8b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) gave Cori Bush an enormous platform. But rather than use that platform to help Missourians take advantage of nearly $300 million in about-to-expire rental support, or rather than lead a sprint to help housing-insecure constituents behind the scenes, Cori Bush made everything about Cori Bush.
On July 30, 2021, as Congress and the White House planned to allow a pandemic-era federal eviction moratorium to expire, Bush "took a page from her years as an activist," [as ](https://substack.com/redirect/65a69065-fdd0-4043-940f-eede49eeb709?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)_[The New York Times](https://substack.com/redirect/65a69065-fdd0-4043-940f-eede49eeb709?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)_[ wrote](https://substack.com/redirect/65a69065-fdd0-4043-940f-eede49eeb709?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), and kicked off a Capitol sit-in. President Biden yielded a few days later.
Here's the problem: the concession was meaningless. A month before, the Supreme Court [had explicitly telegraphed](https://substack.com/redirect/0229497e-6b6e-4e5b-a2ac-25e7b2e94157?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) that it would not allow the evictions moratorium to stand. And sure enough, less than two weeks later, the [Court did exactly what they said they would](https://substack.com/redirect/29c8876e-a6e1-4c05-8307-370372694093?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), nullifying Biden's executive order.
While Bush was grabbing headlines for herself, **$295 million out of $325 million of rental assistance funds allocated for Missouri remained unspent** , according to the Missouri Housing Development Commission.
Had Bush spent those critical two weeks using her megaphone to bring media attention to all of the available resources, she likely could have helped thousands of Missourians pay off up to a year of back rent, and even pay forward rent for up to three months.
But she chose to do nothing to help her constituents.
### **The FBI is investigating her for some old-school corruption**
Of course, if all of that weren't enough, Bush is [being investigated by the Department of Justice and the Federal Elections Commission](https://substack.com/redirect/39ee445e-7db6-4b68-8c06-1f51cbaf8556?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) for using campaign funds to pay her now-husband--[who has no qualifications to serve as a security guard](https://substack.com/redirect/9d13756a-5df5-4457-a7f6-a6f278628360?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)--to be part of her security team.
She's also using her campaign account [to pay her personal legal bills](https://substack.com/redirect/db32e6cc-8b06-4c12-a28a-e70e1346c070?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), to the tune of about $100,000.
Four years in Congress may not have been enough time to accomplish anything, but if being a politician means some baseline level of corruption, she certainly seems to be excelling at that! Private security, a job for your partner, and campaign-funded lawyers for yourself is one hell of a grift.

### **Cori Bush has nothing to show for her four years in Congress**
Throughout her reelection bid, Cori Bush claims over $2 billion in investments that she's brought to St. Louis. Thanks to some terrific reporting from [Mark Maxwell](https://substack.com/redirect/77b5f842-2116-4573-bcdf-559abc4d52d1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) at KSDK, [the reality is--generously--one-tenth of that](https://substack.com/redirect/31dd866f-b67f-430d-ad08-f9174a668ab2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
When you remove her fictitious accomplishments, [Bush's superlatives](https://substack.com/redirect/3ca7ed02-f690-4752-88cc-a9ae037bcd59?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)3 are rather unimpressive:
* Got bipartisan cosponsors on the fewest bills compared to House Democrats
* Got their bills out of committee the least often compared to Missouri Delegation
* Held the fewest committee positions compared to Missouri Delegation

### **To a fault, Cori Bush is uncompromisingly partisan**
The vast majority of Americans still want more bipartisanship--[87%, to be exact](https://substack.com/redirect/4660037f-2e9d-4fa5-9ba5-92d2b035bcd7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). It's why we're seeing more moderate candidates win in primaries.4
Nonetheless, the House is still a group of America's 435 most uncompromising ideologues, hacks, nut-jobs, and sanctimonious pricks.5 So when you're [third-from-the-bottom](https://substack.com/redirect/04da8375-ee78-4b42-8b47-bfb2eeca4b91?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) on the bipartisanship index, it _really_ says something:
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/04da8375-ee78-4b42-8b47-bfb2eeca4b91?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
### **And speaking of Cori Bush on the same list with some of the nuttiest Republicans ...**
She almost never reaches across the aisle to work with Republicans. But when she does, she likes to work with the craziest of them.
Take her "no" vote on [sanctions against Russia](https://substack.com/redirect/9fb0d283-c44c-4371-9074-57f9b575b890?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), where she was one of only two Democrats to team up with Lauren Boebert, Marjorie Taylor Greene, and Matt Gaetz after the invasion of Ukraine.
Don't worry, though: her crazy isn't limited to voting with Republicans. She was one of only two people to vote against a bill that would [deny immigration benefits for Hamas terrorists](https://substack.com/redirect/1f3eb4dc-35e5-4350-bf98-313abe23770f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), for example.
I won't linger on Bush's stance on Israel, which has obviously attracted a lot of attention and a lot of controversy. But it is worth noting that despite [roughly 60,000 Jews living in St. Louis](https://substack.com/redirect/727180ef-e67a-49f0-8371-091dba8ce910?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), "Bush has largely refused to engage with the mainstream Jewish community since she first took office in 2021," [according to community leaders](https://substack.com/redirect/37b07877-f2fd-47f8-a4c8-2af08ed7d8a9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
That includes [refusing to sit for an interview](https://substack.com/redirect/d7679073-197f-430f-bcd1-0998a8bf5476?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) with the _St. Louis Jewish Light_ newspaper and having [met with only one local Jewish group in four years in office](https://substack.com/redirect/706758f4-6e4d-420e-b1cb-40b7ba0753aa?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), despite repeated requests from numerous organizations.
These are organizations which, in many cases, [do not take positions on Israel](https://substack.com/redirect/d6068c19-e82b-41f7-97ef-31933e70e468?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) or the conflict in the Middle East. Rather, they represent her constituents and people in her community. But her refusal to meet with them has been steadfast, and that's alarming. And so when she [votes against resolutions to condemn antisemitism](https://substack.com/redirect/21d292ca-ac20-42f2-8e82-be8155a67efc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), as she did at the end of last year, that's deeply problematic.6
### **Why this matters**
As a region, St. Louis faces enormous challenges. As a country, we face enormous challenges. And I believe strongly that we need people who are serious about governing and addressing the huge challenges we face as a country.
After four years in office, it's clear that Cori Bush is not up to the challenge. America, Missouri, and St. Louis deserve better.

The point here is not to draw an equivalency between far-left and far-right elected officials. There isn't one. It's rather to say that Americans are craving more moderate and more sane politics, and we're seeing voters in both parties move towards that.

Friend, It's my birthday today, and I'm spending it ensuring that the war criminal Benjamin Netanyahu knows that this Palestinian proudly exists in Congress. After nine months of Israel’s escalating and well-documented genocide against the Palestinian people, bipartisan House and Senate leaders gave Israel’s Prime Minister a rare honor by formally inviting him to address Congress today. This invitation came _after_ the International Criminal Court’s top prosecutor announced that he’s seeking an arrest warrant against Netanyahu for well-documented violations of international law. **Instead of honoring Netanyahu, we must hold him accountable.** That’s why activists are gathering in Washington, DC today to protest his speech and call for his arrest. As Israel’s genocidal Prime Minister Netanyahu continues with his U.S.-backed ethnic cleansing campaign in Gaza and his push to occupy more of the West Bank, I will continue to uplift the humanity of the Palestinian people. **I’m the only Palestinian American serving in Congress, and I will not be bullied to be silent or invisible.** I will continue reminding my colleagues that Palestinians are human beings who deserve freedom and dignity. Too many leaders in our government are dehumanizing and erasing Palestinians, which also endangers Palestinians in the United States who are subject to a rise in racist attacks. One other Palestinian American previously served in Congress, and he has unfortunately lost multiple members of his family who were killed in Gaza during this genocide. Shamefully, our federal government is the top funder of these atrocities, as well as the top weapons provider for the Israeli military. Now we have a chance to push a new Democratic nominee for President to change course and heed the majority of the American people, who want an arms embargo and an end to their tax dollars funding apartheid and genocide. I will keep speaking up, echoing calls from courageous people across the world who have not backed down in saying: Palestinians deserve to live, and we need a ceasefire now! [**Can you chip into my re-election campaign today to show that we will not back down in demanding a ceasefire and equal human rights for the Palestinian people?**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfquOHcLBgxPM8BvU03c-wnyW4jSGnq7P0-0DX_hMNV5sFENqJZbg4-W8goxU_RqFkfTnznVloTTSAXJVHMLHWzKqYe2bHVw-Z3XAhP1xPbJ-QflAkL9vXWD9CKecIT7KCi3htRL5vge71E6p9S1utZ96Zo2XyyXriL5ra4DpDjTYmVfM20m5_2GzIxAJ1l1JadmemgGuTXA9IiFJMLGEruESQHcJGQ0lnRkhvgxxAJvQAMex1od-G3D80mfHSURiz82xyuIZw_KOXXGk_KYockileoOvVDqf26gKyBWMWAEM0eEEAXnMcfBdZNU2N8t2yJMEePiYhk79lgd139ee335NLgxgFo24ljnwineDJhTMFt5CiMusOZe7fqDWO75byyZYUqqoQPInK3AERaaz1LpEu9TrzJaJrRKF-jD6MH2a8Q/48b/nCr5eqQtQF64yZY_wPtgXg/h1/h001.s-UAWQ5MOdqARczdWaJ9-hSqzs9bd7uthnTokoK_YfE) | [CHIP IN TODAY](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfquOHcLBgxPM8BvU03c-wnyW4jSGnq7P0-0DX_hMNV5sFN3_Da5mhO5zZlwo1_T9WGzCE0GmiQcZHZf1fDepA-H0AJq81qW-Zol4zhx4blMtBKPVgRD9Vt2VqMsdj3LRz_Jov3A-OGjhWlUcuoaQTy-t_6CG1OyULmpE-h9kAusBl5CjZWvf23ouZ8Km_3Exy2SUvmpJQ1ZidrAgCE8RRfaVrnQVxgZ1hCFciRgTuGT9JXO-4AqTAdQGUHBSRWz1__GfUlIs4R5hsKOzWoHUAHiX63i-Wd8dy-dINJm0LdrkP835aqqwvTBhdTuQRoRRGAdl3f9RqHZKYP4R88G7jcedRuF92ssrQhfe_rGyHlqaACfePs3VyxmvRHknmkPm1OQf_TXs-oTw3pPH0e0biPY2gDw4G6dLpJh2NPu4fkDfLw/48b/nCr5eqQtQF64yZY_wPtgXg/h2/h001.haOqWkAIz6VVBEZqqdhAS7qOZiF5txh3mYXeLhzvAKY)

Thank you for joining me in the push for Palestinian freedom and against oppression everywhere.
Just last week, the world’s top court affirmed what Palestinians and human rights organizations have said for years: Israel’s government is committing the crime of apartheid. The International Court of Justice has demanded reparations for Palestinians and an end to Israel’s illegal military occupation of the West Bank, East Jerusalem, and Gaza. This is in addition to the court's earlier rulings ordering Israel’s government to stop the violence in Gaza and allow in humanitarian aid to Gaza immediately. Now countries must act to enforce these rulings, including the United States.
Together, we will continue demanding and building a world that values all life equally, no matter ethnicity or background.
In solidarity,
Rashida

body:
We’ve been told our whole lives to eat certain fruits, vegetables, and whole grains to stay in good health.

We've been told our whole lives to eat certain fruits, vegetables, and whole grains to stay in good health.
However, according to Dr. Steven Gundry — a world-renowned heart surgeon — many so called **" health foods" in the American diet contain a dangerous toxin, that could be expanding your waistline.**
**" This toxin causes micro-tears to form in your fragile intestinal-wall — allowing bacteria and waste products to seep into your body."** Says Dr. Gundry.
This harmful condition is best known as "leaky gut," and it's affecting millions of people nationwide. **Warning signs include weight gain, fatigue, digestive discomfort, stiff, achy joints, and even skin problems.**
Dr. Gundry explains, "**These side effects are often mistaken for normal signs of aging, because leaky gut usually develops over a matter of years, and sometimes even decades. But I can assure you, the damage caused by these so called "health foods" is far from normal."**
The good news is, this problem can be **easily fixed from your own home.**
"It's very simple, you just have to know which foods are actually healthy, and which contain this hidden toxin," he goes on to explain.
By simply eliminating this harmful toxin, Dr. Gundry has seen thousands of his own patients make swift recoveries. (In fact, he even lost 70lbs himself!)
Now, after years of research, Dr. Gundry has decided to release an informative video to the public — free and uninterrupted — showcasing exactly which foods you need to avoid.
"Good health is one of life's toughest obstacles," he explains. "So, if this video can help people achieve that, I'll be thrilled to hear I was of help."
The video has since gone viral, first being shared by users on Facebook, then being featured on news sites like ABC and CBS.
So far, the comments and feedback have been outstanding, with thousands of Americans feeling better than they have in decades.

Dr. Gundry also serves as the personal physician to many A-list celebrities.
Most notable of which include legendary self-help guru Tony Robbins, Oscar award winning actor Alan Arkin, Grammy award winning singer Usher, and countless fortune 500 executives.
Now, there is one thing Dr. Gundry asks from his viewers: "If watching this helps you take control of your weight back, fight unwanted cravings, increase your energy, ease gas and bloating, or find relief from stiff, achy joints," Dr. Gundry says... body:
We always knew that this would be one of the closest races in the country. That’s no secret. But we’ve been really fortunate so far because month after month we have absolutely crushed Kari Lake’s fundraising numbers. That gives us a tremendous advantage, and it lets us deliver our message to the people who need to hear it.
#
[](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/1212?c0=longrunpac-em-gallego-split.yaQa6D&refcode=em240724-1-c&refcode2=5356.196590.dWDy-o&t=1&akid=5356%2E196590%2EdWDy-o)

Friend, Kari Lake directly addressed the Republican National Convention last week.
She had a prime-time slot, one of the biggest of the night. I’m not going to speculate on how many people watched, but I can tell you one thing for sure: It was the biggest platform she’s ever had.
We always knew that this would be one of the closest races in the country. That’s no secret. But we’ve been really fortunate so far because month after month we have absolutely crushed Kari Lake’s fundraising numbers. That gives us a tremendous advantage, and it lets us deliver our message to the people who need to hear it.
All that could change in an instant, though. The kind of national attention that Kari Lake got could turn into millions of dollars raised in the blink of an eye. Big donors send in massive checks, the millions of MAGA faithful add their donations, and before you know it we’re the ones getting crushed. It’s Kari Lake’s ads flooding the airwaves and our chances at defending Arizona and holding the U.S. Senate collapse.
The only way we’ll prevent that from happening is if we continue to raise the resources we need to win.
I need you with me. It’s as simple as that.

Last year, 82% of Senate races and 94% of House races were won by the candidate who spent the most money. Since we were narrowly outraised last quarter, this is worrying news. To defy the odds and beat our mega-millionaire opponent, we need your help. It’s only with a powerful movement of supporters from across the Commonwealth that we’ll be able to STOP David McCormick from buying Pennsylvania’s Senate seat. Please use the links in this email to start a monthly donation through ActBlue. Together, we’ll win this race and keep Bob in the Senate fighting for PA families. — Team Casey

| | **Team Eigel is Traveling the State! Join Us!**
* * *
I have tremendous news: The surge we are experiencing is very real. I am traveling across the entire state visiting with thousands of Missourians, and every single one of our events is packed with enthusiastic conservatives eager to put in the work to help us win on August 6th!

My message of a bold, conservative Missouri where we eliminate personal property tax and income tax, deport illegals, and ban foreign countries from buying our land is resonating. Republican voters are ready for the reckoning!

In just the last few days, we have hosted events in [St. James](https://billeigel.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=00ef1c295ae4331d7c1e52945&id=0ccf58e3fe&e=c00a6982d2), [Lebanon](https://billeigel.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=00ef1c295ae4331d7c1e52945&id=74df6ba884&e=c00a6982d2), [Ozark](https://billeigel.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=00ef1c295ae4331d7c1e52945&id=aa35a70f49&e=c00a6982d2), [Reeds Spring](https://billeigel.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=00ef1c295ae4331d7c1e52945&id=40a2b29cfc&e=c00a6982d2), [Bolivar](https://billeigel.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=00ef1c295ae4331d7c1e52945&id=aef158c97d&e=c00a6982d2), [Nevada](https://billeigel.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=00ef1c295ae4331d7c1e52945&id=f2526fe5c8&e=c00a6982d2), [Harrisonville](https://billeigel.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=00ef1c295ae4331d7c1e52945&id=da767b8086&e=c00a6982d2), [St. Joseph](https://billeigel.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=00ef1c295ae4331d7c1e52945&id=954f60930f&e=c00a6982d2), and [Cape Girardeau](https://billeigel.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=00ef1c295ae4331d7c1e52945&id=d69b31eb14&e=c00a6982d2). In the next few days, I will be in [Washington](https://billeigel.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=00ef1c295ae4331d7c1e52945&id=f3d81a2051&e=c00a6982d2), [Sikeston](https://billeigel.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=00ef1c295ae4331d7c1e52945&id=a7a15b5671&e=c00a6982d2), [Kennett](https://billeigel.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=00ef1c295ae4331d7c1e52945&id=d93e8ef0cd&e=c00a6982d2), [Ironton](https://billeigel.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=00ef1c295ae4331d7c1e52945&id=e50f96611f&e=c00a6982d2), [Farmington](https://billeigel.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=00ef1c295ae4331d7c1e52945&id=0d696c93e6&e=c00a6982d2), Pilot Grove, Jefferson City, and a town near you! | | **Mike Kehoe Dodges Debate and Fundraises with the Biden Campaign**
* * *
Let me get this straight. Mike Kehoe cannot attend the only statewide televised Missouri governor debate tomorrow, because he has a fundraiser or something. He DOES have time, this week, for a big video presentation at a black tie ball alongside the Biden Campaign, crazy defund the police Congresswoman Cori Bush, and other Democrat politicians. **Mike Kehoe appears on flyer alongside Biden's MO campaign manager and Cori Bush**
| | **Mike Kehoe Calls My Plan to Detain and Deport Illegals "Foolish" and "not Practical"**
* * *
At the RNC Convention, patriots rallied around President Trump's immigration plan and his calls for "mass deportation now." I support it 100%, but my opponent, Mike Kehoe, called deportation "foolish" and "not practical." Kehoe sounds like a Democrat.

>From the [Springfield Daily Citizen](https://billeigel.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=00ef1c295ae4331d7c1e52945&id=0a6f881418&e=c00a6982d2): "Kehoe said as he travels the state, it does not take long for voters to bring up the issue of illegal immigration - but he says it is foolish to think ([as his competitor Eigel urges](https://billeigel.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=00ef1c295ae4331d7c1e52945&id=9bfb0f276b&e=c00a6982d2)) that the state could round up an estimated 77,000 people in Missouri who are without proper documentation."
---
|

| | **Tax Hike Mike Kehoe is Trying to Run from His Liberal Democrat Record; Here are the Facts.**
* * *
❌ 2013: Kung Pao Kehoe voted 4x to sell Missouri land to foreign countries like China. He took $8500 in campaign contributions in 4 separate checks from the Chinese-owned company who bought our land.
❌ 2013: Mike Kehoe's 2013 vote on the "Missouri Non-Discrimination Act" (MONA) would have allowed the erasure of traditional marriage, biological men in women's restrooms and facilities, and the violation of MIssourians' 1st amendment rights and religious beliefs.
❌ 2014: Tax Hike Mike authored the largest tax increase in Missouri history, a sales tax increase which would have cost taxpayers almost $8 billion.
❌ 2015: Tax Hike Mike voted to pass a 3.5 cent per gallon diesel tax increase which would have hurt MO farmers.
❌ 2018: Tax Hike Mike campaigned for Proposition D, which would have raised gas taxes 10 cents per gallon.
❌ 2021: Tax Hike Mike supports a 12.5 cent gas tax hike, which was signed into law despite the voters rejecting gas tax increases at the ballot box multiple times previously.

Check out Mike Kehoe's liberal record [here](https://billeigel.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=00ef1c295ae4331d7c1e52945&id=c7323f37e1&e=c00a6982d2).

Friend, **FIRST:****** Big Oil spent decades lying to the public about the impacts of climate change. Year over year, executives for corporations like ExxonMobile and Chevron have raked in billions of dollars in profits at the expense of our planet. **THEN:****** As the chair of the Subcommittee on the Environment, we brought Big Oil executives to testify before Congress in 2021 and began to hold them accountable for their role in accelerating the effects of climate change. **NOW:****** I’m being attacked by Big Oil for putting people and the environment before their bottom line. [**Before I explain, will you rush a $10 contribution to my campaign to challenge Big Oil’s corruption?** ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/89474356/487418704/-1459152354?refcode=20240724&amount=10&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDMyMDUiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiZGQ0YmUyNmQtZDc0OS1lZjExLTg2YzMtNjA0NWJkZDllMDk2IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=rY2Vj3HnQWpNyS51PO-wf0F1QzhlSvINr43rGu6QsZg=)

| | Since joining the House of Representatives, I have fought tirelessly to hold Big Oil accountable for exploiting hardworking Americans and fueling the climate crisis:

Thank you to all who participated (and keep an eye on your inbox, because we will be announcing the results soon!) But before we do, we wanted to share two more ways that you can pitch in — at this crucial moment in our nation’s history — to help us block right-wing extremists and build governing power for the multi-racial working class, from now through November: 1\. to make sure we have the resources we need to hire organizers in key races, fund our volunteer phone banks and texting programs, run ads to share our message with voters, and grow our movement up and down the ballot right now. 2\. **** Peter, I know the news has been overwhelming lately, but I want to make sure we pause to acknowledge something important that could soon be in danger.

This week is the 34th anniversary of the watershed legislation, the _Americans with Disabilities Act_ – which you probably think of as the ADA.

**The ADA is one of the most significant pieces of civil rights legislation in American history** – prohibiting discrimination against people with disabilities or any physical impairment and guaranteeing equal opportunities and access for all in our schools and workplaces, buildings and transportation, and in every area of our public life.

But now legislation like the ADA is coming under threat from the GOP as they embrace the Project 2025 agenda which seeks to dismantle government agencies and protections of all kinds, from the environment to accessibility to consumer rights. **It’s one more thing we’re fighting for this election year, and we’re going to have to speak up about what’s at stake.**

**So I want to hear from you right now, do you support the ADA?[Instantly add your name if you do.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/89480859/487438088/1382137467?amount=25&refcode=07232024_MD_EN_ADA_1&refcode2=adf98a44-e049-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDQ1OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhZGY5OGE0NC1lMDQ5LWVmMTEtODZjMy02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=6we72E_L3NjRF74bYwMjuriz95CtzPuA-lMkJvYgP24=)**

I’ve prioritized the needs and challenges of hard working Pennsylvanians since being elected as a PA State Rep – and the ADA provides a legal foundation for much of that work. Here are just a few examples from my time in Congress:
* Expanded disability rights and qualifications for our veterans

* Funded programs aimed at helping our children with disabilities get the help they need in schools

* Introduced legislation to make voting more accessible to disabled Americans

* Removed access barriers for disabled people running for office

My Democratic colleagues and I are working to ensure that every American gets the support, accommodations, and funding they need to thrive in this country.

But I’m worried that the GOP and their far-right agenda are going to gut the ADA and all of the work we’ve done. I don’t intend on letting that happen, and I need to know if you’re by my side.

Hey team,
July is Disability Pride Month, and we’re fighting for the principle that all means _all_.
Young Americans of all backgrounds and abilities play a crucial role in shaping our future and together, we can focus on building a more inclusive society.
It’s 2024 and somehow our country still has antiquated laws that disproportionately affect those with disabilities. With a lack of opportunity, some people have their benefits _constantly_ at risk, and some can’t even get married.
_That’s f*cked up._
While we can celebrate the diverse strengths and contributions of people with disabilities, there are still countless barriers we must tear down. Everyone deserves an opportunity to thrive.
The fight for equality continues. There’s no reason that people with disabilities should be facing employment discrimination or barred from opportunities due to accessibility issues. Change needs to happen.

body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/avlon-donate-general?refcode=emq3 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/avlon-donate-general?refcode=emq3]
Friends,
A few days ago, I asked you about what YOUR top priorities are. So many of you responded that it took a while to read through all of them. But I loved every minute of it because of your enthusiasm and ideas.
We need to get past the DC hyper-partisan division and get excited about citizen-driven solutions again. And so that kind of feedback really fires me up – it’s a sign of a campaign that can make real change. It’s why I’m running for Congress.
Before I get into the results, we need to make sure that we are translating this enthusiasm into actual votes. At a critical pivot point in the election season, we need to keep building momentum and moving forward. If you’re able, please pitch in so we can take the fight to Trump flunky Nick LaLota and win in November >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/avlon-donate-general?refcode=emq3]
Now, for the results. Here’s what you had to say about the issues surrounding our community:
- 61% of you marked climate change as a top priority. It’s no wonder, because in Suffolk County, the environment is the economy, and the economy is the environment: from farming to fishing to tourism. Combating climate change based on facts shouldn’t be a partisan issue. To do that, I’ll aim to serve on the Water Resources and Environment Subcommittee if elected to Congress. I also believe it should be tax deductible for families and businesses to make their properties more resilient. We need to invest in beach re-nourishment on a regular basis. And we need to develop the next generation of clean energy technology right here on Long Island.
- When asked about what matters to you most nationally, 82% of you chose protecting democracy. I loved reading this because democracy - and the values that go with it - is the foundation on which our country is built. The best way to protect democracy? By using the power of democracy in November. Don’t forget that Donald Trump tried to overturn an election on the back of a lie and was re-nominated by Republicans anyway. We need to defeat Trumpism at the ballot box once and for all so that we can restore common sense problem solving to congress.
- I also asked about the best way to fix the problems we have here on Long Island, and the answers that I saw pop up the most were a commitment to bipartisanship, clear communication and collaboration. I couldn’t agree more. From the beginning, I’ve run my campaign like a conversation, and if elected, that’s how I’ll run my office. That starts with doing things like holding in person town halls, something Nick LaLota’s afraid to do.
- And yes, I did ask you what you think I’d order next time I ran into you at a restaurant - because who said priorities had to always be about politics? You’re right about me digging a good burger. Here’s a couple favorites: Try the Smoke Burger at The Shed in Huntington or the Bison Burger at Tweed’s in Riverhead.
Aside from the food recs - I’m not kidding when I tell you your responses are helping us set our priorities, too. Part of how we got into this mess is politicians so stuck into hyper-partisanship that they forget how they got elected in the first place – as one of you said, the Trumpers in Congress are more interested in holding onto power than solving problems. I couldn’t agree more. The alternative is a commitment to common sense problem solving that rebuilds the middle of our politics and rebuilds the middle of our economy, always listening to fellow citizens and earning their votes. The key is having real conversations. I’m never losing sight of that.
We’ve just got to win this race. I need your help – can you pitch in today? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/avlon-donate-general?refcode=emq3]
Thank you for all your support and thoughts – and thanks for fighting the good fight with me.
-John

clean_body: [] Friends, A few days ago, I asked you about what YOUR top priorities are. So many of you responded that it took a while to read through all of them. But I loved every minute of it because of your enthusiasm and ideas. We need to get past the DC hyper-partisan division and get excited about citizen-driven solutions again. And so that kind of feedback really fires me up – it’s a sign of a campaign that can make real change. It’s why I’m running for Congress. Before I get into the results, we need to make sure that we are translating this enthusiasm into actual votes. At a critical pivot point in the election season, we need to keep building momentum and moving forward. If you’re able, please pitch in so we can take the fight to Trump flunky Nick LaLota and win in November >> [] Now, for the results. Here’s what you had to say about the issues surrounding our community: - 61% of you marked climate change as a top priority. It’s no wonder, because in Suffolk County, the environment is the economy, and the economy is the environment: from farming to fishing to tourism. Combating climate change based on facts shouldn’t be a partisan issue. To do that, I’ll aim to serve on the Water Resources and Environment Subcommittee if elected to Congress. I also believe it should be tax deductible for families and businesses to make their properties more resilient. We need to invest in beach re-nourishment on a regular basis. And we need to develop the next generation of clean energy technology right here on Long Island. - When asked about what matters to you most nationally, 82% of you chose protecting democracy. I loved reading this because democracy - and the values that go with it - is the foundation on which our country is built. The best way to protect democracy? By using the power of democracy in November. Don’t forget that Donald Trump tried to overturn an election on the back of a lie and was re-nominated by Republicans anyway. We need to defeat Trumpism at the ballot box once and for all so that we can restore common sense problem solving to congress. - I also asked about the best way to fix the problems we have here on Long Island, and the answers that I saw pop up the most were a commitment to bipartisanship, clear communication and collaboration. I couldn’t agree more. From the beginning, I’ve run my campaign like a conversation, and if elected, that’s how I’ll run my office. That starts with doing things like holding in person town halls, something Nick LaLota’s afraid to do. - And yes, I did ask you what you think I’d order next time I ran into you at a restaurant - because who said priorities had to always be about politics? Fellow American,

You may already know who I am from my 27 years as a news anchor in Phoenix, Arizona. Or you may have just met me as I run to become Arizona's next Senator and save our great state. You may even just be meeting me for the first time with this email. Regardless, I'm thrilled to be reaching out to you, and I think this could be the beginning of a great relationship. **My name is Kari Lake, and I'm running for the United States Senate by way of Arizona with the intention to Make America Great Again.**

This email may be longer than most, but I hope you'll give me a few minutes of your time. **[At the end, I'll ask you to donate to my grassroots campaign; first, let me explain why it's so important that you join my team.](https://click.gopactionalert.com/u/click?_t=093aa899b2bd42648f5b5caa6c6024d8&_m=0d9326705d49460697ae4bc36f38bf04&_e=LEOxyscsre09syI12DH9RhnGQm4MhD-WXrR3q5RQInP-fErEPn5UsVNkXWZg4neI-Vc3Drk1XqSypr9aHwCTtLNxuWgzjjJHhtr6y_xm5sE28AtP5mYM35M7s6Ey1b-tjZOSiXU6dYYH9DdEaUNAb1Xa0FfA5d-IDi-PmPb-APyr5inqWVXS24iUbANiqyEsoKZrhF2gXHJmhkX2xq4Lze1rRY9BrWJWLzNuMmHZmRvi9_0emgH2HdxGWD-97AvCVGWXWU_4P4SoqohMkK06Fhh_sUu11hBHHe8lfx1yNbKvFjAhfyt9Dd9UxT1je_dOM9tx-4D4nd2hNDXn4W4n4Y8bizu0iJ_ZL_P-ZGO3m1EuvVKnwcHRavitVZytKyZr-_CTSxNkFHNJMEAntbKoRcU9OrrmMdxqnUqw6IoP_Y8%3D)**

[ ](https://click.gopactionalert.com/u/click?_t=093aa899b2bd42648f5b5caa6c6024d8&_m=0d9326705d49460697ae4bc36f38bf04&_e=LEOxyscsre09syI12DH9RhnGQm4MhD-WXrR3q5RQInP-fErEPn5UsVNkXWZg4neI-Vc3Drk1XqSypr9aHwCTtLNxuWgzjjJHhtr6y_xm5sE28AtP5mYM35M7s6Ey1b-tjZOSiXU6dYYH9DdEaUNAb1Xa0FfA5d-IDi-PmPb-APyr5inqWVXS24iUbANiqyEsoKZrhF2gXHJmhkX2xq4LzbpQmrSoZZvx06wY427PBytZwRv1FxzBJfdcyyqgQnqffiiAPouum1ASF7WoXcSivP7wAPWwGM7dGSURmKFJ_L6ubcjRv4WgDXGu0O9QJyz2WQGjpBwuZtCYq-TMkO5wHfXky8wRJhl4mEqOL8d0WwGI5kkcOqDojPC5u2VlBaP3m5518OVt0g5bU5tRCSL17dpi_1yJVYJdHM9zyr5UvQA%3D)
I was raised with my eight siblings— _yes, eight siblings_ —by working-class parents, a teacher and a nurse. I'm the youngest of Larry and Sheila's nine kids, which means I've always had to fight and earn my right of way. And being one of 9 in a working-class family instilled in me a hard work ethic. I met my husband, Jeff, and have two amazing children with him, Ruby and Leo. And as a Mama Bear, I'll always look out for my cubs, no matter the cost.

[ ](https://click.gopactionalert.com/u/click?_t=093aa899b2bd42648f5b5caa6c6024d8&_m=0d9326705d49460697ae4bc36f38bf04&_e=LEOxyscsre09syI12DH9RhnGQm4MhD-WXrR3q5RQInP-fErEPn5UsVNkXWZg4neI-Vc3Drk1XqSypr9aHwCTtLNxuWgzjjJHhtr6y_xm5sE28AtP5mYM35M7s6Ey1b-tjZOSiXU6dYYH9DdEaUNAb1Xa0FfA5d-IDi-PmPb-APyr5inqWVXS24iUbANiqyEsoKZrhF2gXHJmhkX2xq4LzbpQmrSoZZvx06wY427PBytZwRv1FxzBJfdcyyqgQnqffiiAPouum1ASF7WoXcSivDjejuDN7v0GTQaca_aDWobLWYL_1nInE2X3GzJKN8M4S2IsmD0R9aLuLveG1ip6F7Vqsqh0_VwJXutI8AwUYsJN36LJjqhr3HPb5dQhdA6C9w4zht6sj-FFo53QM0dRJRJfZ81Of6xyeDR44Pzz0gM%3D)
I started a 27-year career in media in my 20s, where I mainly anchored the nightly news, always seeking to bring light to truth in a world that so often covers it up. I endeavored to be a symbol of truth in journalism but eventually had to reject the agenda-driven press and walk away from the mainstream media.

God has a plan for all of us, and his plan has led me to where I am today – running for the United States Senate in Arizona. Now, instead of just putting Arizona First, I can put America First in the Senate alongside President Trump. I believe in being the voice for the silent majority, even if that means putting myself in harm's way. Just like I protect my children, I see myself as America's Mama Bear, and I'll always fight for my cubs.

[ ](https://click.gopactionalert.com/u/click?_t=093aa899b2bd42648f5b5caa6c6024d8&_m=0d9326705d49460697ae4bc36f38bf04&_e=LEOxyscsre09syI12DH9RhnGQm4MhD-WXrR3q5RQInP-fErEPn5UsVNkXWZg4neI-Vc3Drk1XqSypr9aHwCTtLNxuWgzjjJHhtr6y_xm5sE28AtP5mYM35M7s6Ey1b-tjZOSiXU6dYYH9DdEaUNAb1Xa0FfA5d-IDi-PmPb-APyr5inqWVXS24iUbANiqyEsoKZrhF2gXHJmhkX2xq4LzbpQmrSoZZvx06wY427PBytZwRv1FxzBJfdcyyqgQnqffiiAPouum1ASF7WoXcSivMopCLZyYdRbq3DZvGLUIbRRevAu_KCMm5X469jBkdI5KdlgwNq-hUgDJoMDPnBkjAN4TgqeNq9BnEhWN0_ipdOI4dO1V0Q2sCowsaSZlKM_lyAFze_Ul9OB42h7gOjGM8eSURJI9rcaVRN30kL3vuY%3D)
Republicans need to pick up every possible Senate seat to flip the Senate Majority on November 5th, and my race has become a focal point for the nation. My opponent, Ruben Gallego, is another Career Politician and Radical Leftist who's aiming to continue the Left's Radical Marxist agenda. President Trump and America cannot afford to have me lose this election.

All that to say, I have a track record of fighting for what's right, even rejecting bribes from those who sought to silence me and keep me out of this race. I've always put my own ambitions aside to protect my cubs, and putting myself in the political spotlight over the past few years has been no different. But, the good fight is not free; running ads on TV, getting people out to doorknock, and taking care of staffers can get expensive. The Deep State Democrats have sent a flood of millions of dollars into Arizona to try to drown out my campaign. I'm reliant on small-dollar donors just like you who are building a nationwide grassroots movement. **[That's why I'm humbly asking you to send my campaign a donation of whatever you can afford, no donation is too small (or too large) to make a difference.](https://click.gopactionalert.com/u/click?_t=093aa899b2bd42648f5b5caa6c6024d8&_m=0d9326705d49460697ae4bc36f38bf04&_e=LEOxyscsre09syI12DH9RhnGQm4MhD-WXrR3q5RQInP-fErEPn5UsVNkXWZg4neI-Vc3Drk1XqSypr9aHwCTtLNxuWgzjjJHhtr6y_xm5sE28AtP5mYM35M7s6Ey1b-tjZOSiXU6dYYH9DdEaUNAb1Xa0FfA5d-IDi-PmPb-APyr5inqWVXS24iUbANiqyEsoKZrhF2gXHJmhkX2xq4Lze1rRY9BrWJWLzNuMmHZmRvi9_0emgH2HdxGWD-97AvCXi3F4xJ22SkGdRUSc_htanLtwUIGybS8BozNq4teyVejlFb2-XlT_VeNt4nxyrBvHSu_Gnnn65CyKbZe40CuUF9Sz7GcO3w70zSxpDehhGsgJrdGQmyagRrsm1OFISFZEUiOaU2h-iv0ChKEMf23uEM0xsOS39dMJchjixBxh4k%3D) **

If you've made it this far, I want to personally thank you for taking the time to read this email. Maybe you've been a supporter of mine for a long time, or maybe you believe in my mission to put America First and you're joining my team for the first time. **[Either way, can you support my campaign with a donation of just $5 or more before midnight?](https://click.gopactionalert.com/u/click?_t=093aa899b2bd42648f5b5caa6c6024d8&_m=0d9326705d49460697ae4bc36f38bf04&_e=LEOxyscsre09syI12DH9RhnGQm4MhD-WXrR3q5RQInP-fErEPn5UsVNkXWZg4neI-Vc3Drk1XqSypr9aHwCTtLNxuWgzjjJHhtr6y_xm5sE28AtP5mYM35M7s6Ey1b-tjZOSiXU6dYYH9DdEaUNAb1Xa0FfA5d-IDi-PmPb-APyr5inqWVXS24iUbANiqyEsoKZrhF2gXHJmhkX2xq4Lze1rRY9BrWJWLzNuMmHZmRvi9_0emgH2HdxGWD-97AvCmviXadZS8-OaQN3qgr1ss7ecgygToWADADJ6V2eVXc00HwT1rf0nmCCVEtJwKG84QGvraAguQUiVEjFryKhowesyjtiv33_-RnRsH8IhJLvNlBdCjF3YbkHjRNfICiKWPvoptWDYt9AhN19u8xn-T8YSZjmC9kNaOjfShOEErAY%3D) **

Thank you, and God Bless America,
Kari Lake

body:
# [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=1688%2E135344%2En7oFvv)

Friend --
It’s hard to overstate the magnitude of the events of the last few days at the national level, between President Joe Biden’s courageous and historic decision to pass the baton and the groundswell of grassroots support for Vice President Kamala Harris.
But we can’t lose sight of something that _hasn’t_ changed: November’s election will be decided on razor-thin margins in just a handful of states, with Michigan likely being the tipping point.
Whether or not Donald Trump is our next President -- and whether Republicans control the Senate -- may very well be decided by a small slice of voters here in our state.
Because of that, analysts, pundits, and reporters will be watching Michigan’s August 6th primary very closely.
They will look at it as a barometer for voter enthusiasm among Democratic and Republican base voters. Those stories, strange as it may seem, help set a tone for the race at large, carrying over into September, and even October.
On top of that, a primary election like this typically functions as a “dry run” for the voter mobilization efforts that will occur during the general election. And with changes at the top of the ticket, it’s all the more important to ensure that Democrats are able to make the most of the opportunity to mobilize our base and show enthusiasm ahead of November.
Elissa’s name will be on the ballot in Michigan on August 6th. After, we will formally know who our Republican opponent will be in November, and at that point it will be all gas, no brakes through the election.
[**So that’s why we’re asking you today: will you chip in $3 to help Elissa build momentum heading into the general election, not only for our race for U.S. Senate, but for the presidential election as well?**](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-july24.5Fk0a0&refcode=em240724-2-900&t=2&akid=1688%2E135344%2En7oFvv)

body:
Peter, it’s Mark Kelly.
I’m not a take-it-easy kind of person. I’m going to do whatever it takes to protect our razor-thin Senate majority. That’s why I recently visited Pennsylvania — which could determine control of the U.S. Senate — to support my friend Bob Casey who’s in his toughest re-election fight yet.
**[Before I get into it, can you chip in $5 or more to Bob’s campaign?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20240724-3?recurring=1&refcode=em20240724-3&refcode2=3651_552475_4OkHKE&akid=3651%2E552475%2E4OkHKE)**

Bob is a fierce advocate for Pennsylvanians, and we can’t afford to lose his voice in the Senate. But this year, Pennsylvania is one of the battlegrounds in the fight to protect our Senate majority, and Bob is counting on us to get him over the finish line.
Grassroots support was critical for me to win my battleground races in 2020 and 2022, and it’s going to be just as important to keep PA blue in 2024. Bob is going to be up against a wall of cash from National Republicans, so he needs your help.

| **ABOUT NELLA**
**New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years.

Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant.

Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans.

Like her father and mother, Nella has been a warrior for those who most need an advocate: for women competing in academics or business, for families dealing with mental illness, and for those without access to quality healthcare or education. **

clean_body: You have an opportunity to make history by flipping New Mexico red. | Peter, I’ve had the privilege of working behind the scenes in some of the most pivotal political campaigns in recent history. Today, I am reaching out to you on behalf of Nella Domenici , who is running for the United States Senate to represent New Mexico. Nella is a leader with a vision for a better America. As a former business executive and the daughter of a long-term former U.S. Senator, Pete Domenici, she brings unparalleled experience and a deep commitment to serving the people of New Mexico. A few months ago, I wrote in the Wall Street Journal that New Mexico could be a “sleeper” race for Republicans, thanks to Joe Biden’s and Martin Heinrich’s restrictive approach to energy, inflation-increasing economic policies, and dangerous move to keep the border wide open. And that’s exactly what we’re seeing - New Mexico is in play. Now, let’s talk strategy. According to the latest polling, Nella and her far-left opponent are neck and neck. The polls show extremist Democrat Martin Heinrich with only 41 percent among likely voters, while Nella is close behind with 38 percent. Importantly, 21 percent of voters remain undecided. This means this race is up for grabs, and every single vote– every single dollar –counts. That’s also why Nella and Pat recently personally matched up to $1 MILLION toward their campaign. You have an opportunity to make history by flipping New Mexico red. We need your help to ensure Nella’s campaign has the resources to close the gap, defeat Martin Heinrich, and give Republicans a strong majority in the Senate. With this race as close as it is, every single contribution makes a significant difference. Your support is not only appreciated; it’s essential. Sincerely, Karl Rove | ABOUT NELLA New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years. Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant. Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans. Like her father and mother, Nella has been a warrior for those who most need an advocate: for women competing in academics or business, for families dealing with mental illness, and for those without access to quality healthcare or education. disclaimer_text: Paid for by Jane Fonda Climate PAC, not authorized by any candidate or candidate’s committee
body:
Sign the petition to demand action.

| [](https://click.everyaction.com/k/89485475/487454853/1328794144?refcode=ea.ec2b1182-e949-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&ms=ea.ec2b1182-e949-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImVjMmIxMTgyLWU5NDktZWYxMS04NmMzLTYwNDViZGQ5ZTA5NiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=daqLbVMQb-c0e32l614F6OcMGYEhY29iJIzjabws5DI=&emci=41ff58a7-ca49-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&emdi=ec2b1182-e949-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&ceid=4823105)
---
The Supreme Court issued a dangerous decision last month that overturned the Chevron doctrine, which has been the cornerstone of the EPA’s environmental protections for 40 years. The Chevron doctrine ensured that experts at federal agencies like the EPA had the authority to interpret complex environmental laws and enforce regulations based on their scientific expertise. But now, thanks to SCOTUS, that critical authority was handed over to unelected judges who are experts in the law, not in climate science or environmental protection. The ramifications of overturning Chevron are alarming. This ruling is something big polluters and greedy corporations have been actively fighting for. They see fewer regulations as a green light to wreak havoc on our planet. But we’re not taking this lying down. We’re gearing up to demand action, and we need YOU to join us. **[Sign the petition to Congress: Counteract the SCOTUS decision and empower the EPA for strong environmental protections!](https://click.everyaction.com/k/89485477/487454855/-1752287218?source=direct_link&referrer=group-jfcp-woa&redirect=https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jane-bax-email-petition-ccepaja&refcode=ea.ec2b1182-e949-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&ms=ea.ec2b1182-e949-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImVjMmIxMTgyLWU5NDktZWYxMS04NmMzLTYwNDViZGQ5ZTA5NiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=daqLbVMQb-c0e32l614F6OcMGYEhY29iJIzjabws5DI=&emci=41ff58a7-ca49-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&emdi=ec2b1182-e949-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&ceid=4823105)** **We need Congress to step up and pass legislation that restores and strengthens the EPA’s authority to enforce robust environmental protections. This legislation should:**
1. Reaffirm and enhance the EPA’s power to tackle climate change and environmental issues head-on.
2. Ensure that the EPA can base regulations on the latest science and technology.
3. Provide clear guidance to prevent the regulatory chaos that big polluters thrive on.

It's time for bold, decisive action. Our future literally depends on it. Congress needs to counteract this disastrous SCOTUS decision by empowering the EPA and other federal agencies to do what they do best — protect our environment. clean_body: Sign the petition to demand action. | The Supreme Court issued a dangerous decision last month that overturned the Chevron doctrine, which has been the cornerstone of the EPA’s environmental protections for 40 years. The Chevron doctrine ensured that experts at federal agencies like the EPA had the authority to interpret complex environmental laws and enforce regulations based on their scientific expertise. But now, thanks to SCOTUS, that critical authority was handed over to unelected judges who are experts in the law, not in climate science or environmental protection. The ramifications of overturning Chevron are alarming. This ruling is something big polluters and greedy corporations have been actively fighting for. They see fewer regulations as a green light to wreak havoc on our planet. But we’re not taking this lying down. We’re gearing up to demand action, and we need YOU to join us. We need Congress to step up and pass legislation that restores and strengthens the EPA’s authority to enforce robust environmental protections. This legislation should: 1. Reaffirm and enhance the EPA’s power to tackle climate change and environmental issues head-on. 2. Ensure that the EPA can base regulations on the latest science and technology. 3. Provide clear guidance to prevent the regulatory chaos that big polluters thrive on. It's time for bold, decisive action. Our future literally depends on it. Congress needs to counteract this disastrous SCOTUS decision by empowering the EPA and other federal agencies to do what they do best — protect our environment. And let’s not forget: If Trump becomes president again, he could appoint more SCOTUS justices who would further gut the EPA’s power. We cannot afford to let this happen. We must act now to safeguard our environmental protections and ensure a livable future for all. Let's show them that we’re not backing down. | We are louder, stronger, and more united than ever before. The day before the anniversary of the Supreme Court’s disastrous Dobbs decision, I woke up to Fox News and Lauren Boebert attacking my sister and my 81-year-old father.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/89486031/487457025/872526041?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NjIxNiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwN2NkZWVjMS1lYTQ5LWVmMTEtODZjMy02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=_csx4-Ufi0qiKbHaVL38OgsQQbFk7vi7SQdin2NbXaQ=&emci=1c392a54-6649-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&emdi=07cdeec1-ea49-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&ceid=19445147)
[ ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/89486032/487457026/872526041?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NjIxNiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwN2NkZWVjMS1lYTQ5LWVmMTEtODZjMy02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=_csx4-Ufi0qiKbHaVL38OgsQQbFk7vi7SQdin2NbXaQ=&emci=1c392a54-6649-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&emdi=07cdeec1-ea49-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&ceid=19445147)
Hello,
The day before the anniversary of the Supreme Court’s disastrous _Dobbs_ decision, I woke up to Fox News and Lauren Boebert attacking my sister and my 81-year-old father.
For decades, Dad was an OB-GYN. He delivered thousands of babies and wrote books on how to get pregnant and to navigate menopause. Dad provided women with full access to all kinds of reproductive health care, including abortions, in the years right after _Roe_ – and he has now had to watch as women’s reproductive rights are gutted in the aftermath of _Dobbs_.
Dad and his clinic faced many threats over the years. It’s no exaggeration to say that he put his own safety – and that of his family – at risk in order to protect the rights of women to make their own medical decisions.
But I’m not sure he ever expected to see a sitting member of Congress attacking him – or my sister who followed in his footsteps – in a national news outlet. **It’s disgusting. These kinds of personal attacks against my family have no place in our politics and do nothing to serve the people of Western and Southern Colorado.**
If extremists like Lauren Boebert and my new Republican opponent want to have a conversation about reproductive rights in this country, I am more than happy to have that debate. We can talk about how I support _freedom_ and _liberty_ – and how they support big government intruding into the lives of women. We can talk about how they support a national ban on abortion – with no exceptions for rape, incest, or the life of the mother. And we can talk about how they are so extreme, they even want to ban the pill that’s been used by women for decades.
I am willing to talk all day about the fringe view that the government should be dictating women’s medical decisions. **But what I won’t accept is extremists like Lauren Boebert and Fox News attacking my father and my sister.**
I am _incredibly_ proud of my father. He provided health care to women when they needed it during some of the happiest – and most devastating – moments of their lives. Before retirement, he would drive two hours to Planned Parenthood and help teach the next generation of health care providers, like my sister. And no one – not Fox News, and especially not extremists like Lauren Boebert or my new Republican opponent – is going to stop my family from continuing to stand up for a woman’s right to choose.
**We already scared off Lauren Boebert. In 2022, I came just 546 votes shy of winning this House seat. I’m ready to finish the job and replace Boebert in Congress in November, but these are the kinds of ugly attacks that I’m already up against.**
[**Please, if you can afford to, will you give $5 or more right now to my campaign to help me win this critical House seat? Our race was the closest in the entire country in 2022. clean_body: The day before the anniversary of the Supreme Court’s disastrous Dobbs decision, I woke up to Fox News and Lauren Boebert attacking my sister and my 81-year-old father. Hello, The day before the anniversary of the Supreme Court’s disastrous Dobbs decision, I woke up to Fox News and Lauren Boebert attacking my sister and my 81-year-old father. For decades, Dad was an OB-GYN. He delivered thousands of babies and wrote books on how to get pregnant and to navigate menopause. Dad provided women with full access to all kinds of reproductive health care, including abortions, in the years right after Roe – and he has now had to watch as women’s reproductive rights are gutted in the aftermath of Dobbs. Dad and his clinic faced many threats over the years. It’s no exaggeration to say that he put his own safety – and that of his family – at risk in order to protect the rights of women to make their own medical decisions. But I’m not sure he ever expected to see a sitting member of Congress attacking him – or my sister who followed in his footsteps – in a national news outlet. It’s disgusting. These kinds of personal attacks against my family have no place in our politics and do nothing to serve the people of Western and Southern Colorado. If extremists like Lauren Boebert and my new Republican opponent want to have a conversation about reproductive rights in this country, I am more than happy to have that debate. We can talk about how I support freedom and liberty – and how they support big government intruding into the lives of women. We can talk about how they support a national ban on abortion – with no exceptions for rape, incest, or the life of the mother. And we can talk about how they are so extreme, they even want to ban the pill that’s been used by women for decades. I am willing to talk all day about the fringe view that the government should be dictating women’s medical decisions. But what I won’t accept is extremists like Lauren Boebert and Fox News attacking my father and my sister. I am incredibly proud of my father. He provided health care to women when they needed it during some of the happiest – and most devastating – moments of their lives. Before retirement, he would drive two hours to Planned Parenthood and help teach the next generation of health care providers, like my sister. And no one – not Fox News, and especially not extremists like Lauren Boebert or my new Republican opponent – is going to stop my family from continuing to stand up for a woman’s right to choose. We already scared off Lauren Boebert. In 2022, I came just 546 votes shy of winning this House seat. I’m ready to finish the job and replace Boebert in Congress in November, but these are the kinds of ugly attacks that I’m already up against. = Please use the links in this email to start a weekly donation through ActBlue: | | = | = | | = | = | | = | = I knew this campaign was going to get nasty, but I never expected the other side to go after my family. Milwaukee. We continued that message this week by showing Alaskans in a
NEW television ad
<https://platform.gulfpartyline.com/email/go?c=70592&s=93E87E38-2FE8-4BC
3-A904-E168017696C1&u=63477> that Lieutenant Governor Nancy Dahlstrom
can be a voice for them in Washington and work alongside President
Trump to secure our border, fix our economy, and get our country back
on track.

While Republicans show unity, the Democrats party is in absolute chaos.

Just one week after the Republican National Convention: Joe Biden
dropped out of the presidential race, Kamala Harris received his
endorsement to become the Democratic presidential nominee, and Mary
Peltola refuses to tell us who she supports or where she stands.

Alaskans deserve to know who Mary Peltola is going to support as our
next President of the United States, but when asked who she'll vote
for, she said
<https://platform.gulfpartyline.com/email/go?c=70592&s=93E87E38-2FE8-4BC
3-A904-E168017696C1&u=63478> , "I'm not voting for Trump & I'm not
endorsing anyone else either." Voters deserve to know and, right now,
the only thing they are seeing is unity from Republicans amid Democrat
chaos.

In response to this, Lt. Governor Nancy Dahlstromg released the
following:

"Amid the Democrat chaos, it's time for Mary Peltola to be honest with
Alaskans. Peltola was one of the first House Democrats to endorse
Biden's re-election, she was a keynote speaker at the Alaska Democrat
Party convention, and she's a DNC super delegate. She has stood beside
Biden's anti- Alaska agenda at every step and it's only a matter of
time before she lines up with Kamala Harris. I've been honest with
Alaskans about my support for President Trump and I look forward to
supporting him this November so we can get our country back on track.
When Alaskans head to the ballot box this November, they will remember
the party that presented a clear agenda for prosperity."

Dear Peter,
Robert F. Kennedy Jr. has unveiled a vital initiative: **#AmericaStrong.** #AmericaStrong#AmericaStrong#AmericaStrong#AmericaStrong, restore the prosperity of our people, and ensure that the upcoming election does not end with half of our citizens feeling alienated by the very country they love.
On July 12th, Kennedy introduced **#AmericaStrong** at FreedomFest to a standing ovation. He passionately called for an end to our “cold civil war” before our country descends into political violence. His words proved prophetic...
**Less than 24 hours later, our former president was shot during a rally, and a great American dad in the audience lost his life shielding his family from harm.**
[](https://www.kennedy24.com/america-strong?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=_americastrong_7_24_nd1&n=3#join%20utm_campaign=kennedystrong;utm_medium=email1&utm_source=joinkennedy)
Kennedy has consistently been ahead of the curve on issues such as mandates, lockdowns, corporate capture, and the erosion of our Constitutional freedoms. Now, he warns us of the peril of our internal division and offers **#AmericaStrong** as a path to healing.
“We’ve given the Democrats a chance to fix this country. We’ve given Republicans a chance,” Kennedy said. “What has not had a chance is a unity government, headed by an independent President beholden to no party, free from corporate influence, owing no favors to the Washington establishment, and ready to recruit the best ideas from both parties and from all those who have been left out.”
The America Strong platform will:
* Appoint a cabinet comprising members of the Democratic and Republican parties, as well as Libertarians and people from outside any party.
* Convene a cross-partisan advisory committee to propose and select Supreme Court judges.
* Carefully examine whether any prosecutions of public and private officials were politically motivated and extend pardons to any people who have been politically persecuted.
* Consider pardoning any past president and members of their families if charges against them next year were politically motivated.
* Forbid the weaponization of the Justice Department, the IRS, or any other government agency to surveil or undermine political opponents or their supporters.

We’ve been told our whole lives to eat certain fruits, vegetables, and whole grains to stay in good health.

We've been told our whole lives to eat certain fruits, vegetables, and whole grains to stay in good health.
However, according to Dr. Steven Gundry — a world-renowned heart surgeon — many so called **" health foods" in the American diet contain a dangerous toxin, that could be expanding your waistline.**
**" This toxin causes micro-tears to form in your fragile intestinal-wall — allowing bacteria and waste products to seep into your body."** Says Dr. Gundry.
This harmful condition is best known as "leaky gut," and it's affecting millions of people nationwide. **Warning signs include weight gain, fatigue, digestive discomfort, stiff, achy joints, and even skin problems.**
Dr. Gundry explains, "**These side effects are often mistaken for normal signs of aging, because leaky gut usually develops over a matter of years, and sometimes even decades. But I can assure you, the damage caused by these so called "health foods" is far from normal."**
The good news is, this problem can be **easily fixed from your own home.**
"It's very simple, you just have to know which foods are actually healthy, and which contain this hidden toxin," he goes on to explain.
By simply eliminating this harmful toxin, Dr. Gundry has seen thousands of his own patients make swift recoveries. (In fact, he even lost 70lbs himself!)
Now, after years of research, Dr. Gundry has decided to release an informative video to the public — free and uninterrupted — showcasing exactly which foods you need to avoid.
"Good health is one of life's toughest obstacles," he explains. "So, if this video can help people achieve that, I'll be thrilled to hear I was of help."
The video has since gone viral, first being shared by users on Facebook, then being featured on news sites like ABC and CBS.
So far, the comments and feedback have been outstanding, with thousands of Americans feeling better than they have in decades.
