Hi Peter,
This has been a hectic month in politics, to say the least. But with the election around the corner, we can’t afford to get distracted.
We’re in the most competitive House race in Arizona.
In 2022, we lost by just a percentage point — without national support for our campaign, while my opponent outspent us 6:1.
We’re doing it differently this cycle. We started early and built a strong coalition, getting major endorsements from Planned Parenthood, End Citizens United, and Sierra Club. And we now have my opponent on record voting against reproductive rights, housing, clean energy jobs, and education, meaning he can’t deny his blatant extremism.
In the spring, election trackers like Sabato’s Crystal Ball upgraded our race from “Leans Republican” to “Tossup,” recognizing the strength of our campaign. **It was a win, but it also meant super PACs started funneling millions of dollars into our district to protect the GOP’s House majority.**
We have one week until our end-of-month fundraising deadline — and six days until the Arizona primary.

| **ABOUT NELLA**
**New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years.

Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant.

Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans.

Like her father and mother, Nella has been a warrior for those who most need an advocate: for women competing in academics or business, for families dealing with mental illness, and for those without access to quality healthcare or education. **

body:

| Peter, In the next 48 hours, my team and I have to make difficult budget decisions. We know our TV ads are working — the more people learn about our pro-choice, pro-worker campaign, the more they support us! After July 30th, it looks like Kari Lake will be my opponent. We’ll see how things shake out in their primary, but all signs point to her. And Peter, Kari Lake is just about the last person on earth we’d want to have in the U.S. Senate.
#

Peter -
I know things have been chaotic over the last several weeks. To be honest with you, I’ve been having a hard time keeping up. Between my work in Congress, the campaign, and two kids at home... well, sometimes it feels like there isn’t enough time in a day to stay on top of everything.
But I want to zero you in on something incredibly important right now. Something that isn’t going to go away in a day or two. Our primary election is on July 30th. That’s important, because we need to show that our campaign has what it takes to go the distance between now and then. But it’s important for another reason, too.
After July 30th, it looks like Kari Lake will be my opponent. We’ll see how things shake out in their primary, but all signs point to her.
And Peter, Kari Lake is just about the last person on earth we’d want to have in the U.S. Senate. Put aside the majority that we’re fighting for, the priorities we need to keep working on, everything else. Kari Lake is Trump’s biggest cheerleader, bar none. She undermines our elections. She pals around with Q Anon conspiracy theorists and people like Marjorie Taylor Greene and Steve Bannon.
She’s dangerous. Period. I’m going to do everything I can to turn out our voters and defeat her, but if we don’t raise what we need she will be the next U.S. Senator from Arizona.
If you are ready to double down on this race and help me, there’s no better moment than now.

# I Love America
### Standing with Donald Trump
| | | [Dan Carr](https://substack.com/@dancarr2014)
---
| Jul 24
---
| [](https://substack.com/@dancarr2014)
---
Dear Friend,
As proud Americans, we cherish the values of freedom, opportunity, and justice that our great nation was founded upon. Our love for America fuels our commitment to preserving and strengthening these ideals for future generations.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/becbc94f-ab3e-4a11-bd7a-8f374050a849?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
In the upcoming election, we face a critical choice. Kamala Harris represents policies that threaten to undermine the very principles that make our country exceptional. Her vision for America includes increased government control, higher taxes, open borders, and policies that will stifle economic growth and individual liberties.
On the other hand, electing Donald Trump means putting us on a path of economic prosperity, strong national security, closed borders, and unwavering support for the Constitution. President Trump has proven he is dedicated to putting America first, championing policies that have led to job creation, lower taxes, and a robust economy.
[Why we as christians should be supporting Donald Trump](https://substack.com/redirect/f3419785-5291-4e13-a9ce-8487eeb4b174?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

body:
[ https://act.hillharper.com/go/422?t=1001&akid=1303%2E62735%2EYLBJIV ]Hill Harper for Senate

Peter,

I hope this message finds you well. As we gear up for the crucial battle
ahead to represent Michigan in the U.S. Senate, I'm reaching out to share
some disappointing news regarding the state of our democratic process.

You may recall the recent cancellation of the bipartisan U.S. Senate
debate that was scheduled for May 30th, during the Mackinac Policy
Conference. This cancellation was not due to lack of interest from the
candidates, but rather the refusal of Elissa Slotkin to participate at the
last minute. This last-minute cancellation undermines our democratic
principles and deprives Michigan citizens of the opportunity to hear
directly from those vying for their trust.

Now, with only 13 days left until the election, Slotkin continues to evade
open discourse.

The only debate she has agreed to is a closed event, excluding broad
access to the community. This debate will not be televised. No cameras,
audience, or reporters are allowed.

Such conditions are an affront to the democratic process and deprive
voters of the chance to evaluate candidates side by side, scrutinize their
platforms, and make informed decisions.

Hill Harper remains committed to transparency, accountability, and the
values that represent the best interests of Michigan families and
communities. He believes that every voter deserves the chance to hear
directly from their candidates, to ask tough questions, and to demand
answers.

As we move forward in this campaign, we need your support more than ever.
Together, we can stand up against the trend of political evasion and
ensure that the voices of Michigan citizens are heard loud and clear.

[ https://act.hillharper.com/go/2096?t=1002&akid=1303%2E62735%2EYLBJIV ]But time is running out! With only 13 days left, every action you take
is crucial. Please consider making a donation today and help us win this
fight for a better Michigan.

Together, we can bring real change to Michigan. Let’s show Slotkin that
the people demand a candidate who is willing to stand up, speak out, and
debate the issues head-on.

Thank you for your unwavering support.

Best regards,

Team Harper

It’s been an eventful couple of months, Peter.
FIRST: AIPAC and their GOP megadonors successfully bought their way into Jamaal Bowman’s race.
THEN: Those very same megadonors started pouring millions of dollars into my race in an attempt to buy this seat for my opponent.
NOW: GOP extremists have made it clear that should they win in November, they will systematically roll back our civil rights, freedoms, and environmental protections.
Needless to say, the pressure is on.
The GOP extremists are threatened by regular, everyday people like us having a voice in Congress, and I’m not letting that faze me. Instead, I’m spending my time in the community, talking to our community members, and I am more determined than ever to stay in this seat — because I love this district.
Check out some highlights from the campaign trail and then chip in to help us hit our fundraising goal before our last end-of-month deadline before the primary! Your support means the world to me. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/upliftcoribush?refcode=X_072424_recap]

I felt empowered uniting with change-makers State Senator Karla May, Executive Director of Better Family Life DeBorah Ahmed, and Mayor Tishaura Jones at the Juneteenth Festival.

As a survivor of gun violence myself, when Dr. LJ Punch came to us for a grant to help expand the Bullet Related Injury Clinic, I knew we had to get it done. I’m proud to deliver $3 million in funding for North St. Louis—16x the amount requested—to help save lives.
The last few months have been booked and busy. However, there’s nothing I love more than getting a chance to be in the community and deliver for the people of St Louis.
Together, we’re going to show every corporate super PAC and right-wing special interest group that organized people beat organized money. That’s because our movement is one built on the values of shared humanity, justice, and speaking truth to power for people in St. Louis and around the world.
Will you become part of our support network by chipping in whatever you can now? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/upliftcoribush?refcode=X_072424_recap]
I can’t thank you enough for your ongoing support and I look forward to continuing our work together – because we have a lot more to do, Peter.
I appreciate you always,
Thank you,
Cori

_**As Secretary of State, it’s my job to ensure that our voting is safe and secure. We now have even more evidence it is!**_
Virgil Wiebe, a professor at the University of St. Thomas School of Law, wrote an op-ed published in the Star Tribune about why Minnesota does not have a noncitizen voting issue. It’s based on his study of 13.4 million votes cast by Minnesotans since 2015. He found only 3(!) proven cases of noncitizen voting. **This is good news - and unsurprising.**
**Minnesota does not have a noncitizen voting problem. Period.**
_In fact, our election system has thrived by focusing on security measures that make sense. That's why our elections enjoy the voter confidence that leads to the highest turnout in the nation._

We now have even more evidence it is! Virgil Wiebe, a professor at the University of St. Thomas School of Law, wrote an op-ed published in the Star Tribune about why Minnesota does not have a noncitizen voting issue. It’s based on his study of 13.4 million votes cast by Minnesotans since 2015. He found only 3(!) proven cases of noncitizen voting. This is good news - and unsurprising. Minnesota does not have a noncitizen voting problem. Period. In fact, our election system has thrived by focusing on security measures that make sense. subject: I am running to be President of the United States.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Kaine for Virginia
body:
I am running to be President of the United States.
It has been the honor of a lifetime to serve alongside our Commander-in-Chief, my friend, President Joe Biden — one of the finest public servants we will ever know. And I am honored to have his support and endorsement.
And I am eager to run on the record of what Joe and I have accomplished together. We built our country back after our predecessor left it in shambles -- making historic progress in reducing prescription drug costs, upgrading our nation’s infrastructure, fighting climate change, and more. We are stronger today because we took action -- together -- to invest in America’s future.
I am excited to continue to work toward our vision for a better future for all. But we also need to expand Democrats' majority in the Senate and reelect Tim Kaine to continue to deliver progress for the American people. If that’s all you need to hear, then make your donation to fund my campaign and Tim Kaine’s today. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024-kamala]
If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:

I am honored to have the President’s endorsement and my intention is to earn and win this nomination.
In the coming days, as I hit the campaign trail to meet with Americans and lay out the choice in front of voters in the fall, I cannot imagine two more starkly different visions for where we want our country to go.
We can choose the dark path of Project 2025, with less freedom and more division. Or we can choose to pull together and do the work — For The People.
These are not ordinary times. And this will not be an ordinary election. But this is our America. And I need you with me in this fight. So, I have to ask:
Will you pitch in $30 today to elect me as President of the United States, reelect Tim Kaine, and defeat Donald Trump? Whatever you are able to give in this moment will go a long way in our collective fight. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024-kamala]
Together, I know we can win this election and save democracy.
More soon,
Kamala Harris

By now, you’ve heard about Project 2025, the right-wing plan to remake the American government and turn it into a Christian nationalist state if Trump wins.
Birth control bans, mass deportations, disbanding the EPA and the Department of Education, censoring pornography, and rolling back protections for the LGBTQ+ community – these are just a few of Project 2025’s radical plans.
Despite hundreds of Trump connections, the Trump campaign has tried to distance itself from Project 2025. Trump has even tried to claim he knows nothing about it. 🙄
**If it’s not totally obvious that Trump is lying, consider this: Project 2025 creator Kevin Roberts’ new book about taking over Washington is coming out in September – with a foreword from none other than Trump VP pick JD Vance:**
[****](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/89490359/487472416/-593472309?refcode=20240724-EM-Vance2025&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMzU3MTE4ODAtZjc0OS1lZjExLTg2YzMtNjA0NWJkZDllMDk2IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=XLcFRqS_1CvWsFY0ZeapyumOhUjAmKWxlJu5C81pMIo=)
**[We’ll explain more in a moment, but if you’re ready to expose the Trump campaign’s blatant lies about Project 2025, can you chip in $20 today?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/89490360/487472417/-593472309?refcode=20240724-EM-Vance2025&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMzU3MTE4ODAtZjc0OS1lZjExLTg2YzMtNjA0NWJkZDllMDk2IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=XLcFRqS_1CvWsFY0ZeapyumOhUjAmKWxlJu5C81pMIo=)**
You may remember author (and President of the Heritage Foundation) Kevin Roberts from his viral moment on Steve Bannon’s podcast. When talking about the goals of Project 2025, Roberts said: **“We are in the process of the second American Revolution, which will remain bloodless if the left allows it to be."**
The backlash to Roberts’ alarming threat of right-wing violence is likely the reason the original title of the book was changed from “Burning Down Washington” to “Taking Back Washington.”
**Here’s what we mean:**
[****](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/89490361/487472418/-593472309?refcode=20240724-EM-Vance2025&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMzU3MTE4ODAtZjc0OS1lZjExLTg2YzMtNjA0NWJkZDllMDk2IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=XLcFRqS_1CvWsFY0ZeapyumOhUjAmKWxlJu5C81pMIo=)
So the apocalyptic “Burning Down Washington” is gone, but JD Vance still echoed Roberts’ violence-tinged, revolutionary rhetoric in his glowing Amazon editorial review of the book:
_“Never before has a figure with Roberts’s depth and stature within the American Right tried to articulate a genuinely new future for conservatism... We are now all realizing that it’s time to circle the wagons and load the muskets. In the fights that lay ahead, these ideas are an essential weapon.”
JD Vance, from his editorial review of “Dawn’s Early Light” on Amazon_
**Peter, it’s clear that Project 2025 and its backers pose a serious threat to our rights and democratic freedoms. The Trump campaign's efforts to distance themselves from Project 2025 are laughable, and we have to do everything in our power to make sure voters know just how much is at stake in the upcoming election.**
That’s why we’re proud to offer our rigorous, factual journalism for free in the swing states that will decide who controls the White House. We believe voters should have all the information they need to make an informed choice at the ballot box in November, and that includes exposing Project 2025 and those who back it.

Derek —

I hope this message finds you well. I am excited to inform you about an upcoming opportunity to engage in a national youth call organized by Vice President Kamala Harris' campaign. This call will focus on learning more about the campaign and exploring ways for us to get involved in supporting her historic candidacy.
---

clean_body: Join us this Thursday at 6:30 pm EST for our call, and bring your friends! | | | Peter, 🥥 Did you just fall out of a coconut tree? Well, we exist in the context in which we live; right now, that means multiple historical events taking place this past week and a very high-stakes election this November! President Biden dropping out of the presidential race and endorsing Vice President Harris may not have been on our bingo cards. 😮💨 Join us to discuss the recent events and to strategize with renewed focus and energy for the weeks and months ahead. We’ll explain what these changes mean for our communities and discuss how our movement can defeat an agenda that would roll back the tide on decades of rights and freedoms our movements have won! 🗳️ The name at the top of the ticket has changed, but our commitment and our responsibility remains the same — we must fight for the safety and dignity of our people.Our loyalty has never been to a politician, but to each other and our communities. Thanks for being part of our community, Peter. ✅ Michelle and the rest of the UWD Action Team | Follow us on: | | | | | Paid for by United We Dream Action; UnitedWeDreamAction.org; Not authorized by any candidate or candidate’s committee.

Swiss billionaire Hansjörg Wyss has been channeling substantial funds into American state ballot initiatives through the 1630 Fund aka Sixteen Thirty Fund, a progressive advocacy group.As reported by Americans for Public Trust, Wyss’s donations, which total around $243 million to the group, have been instrumental in influencing policies across various states, with a significant focus on Michigan. Since 2017, nearly $34 million has been funneled into Michigan to, among other goals, "rewrite the state’s election laws." This massive infusion of cash aims at bolstering liberal causes from immigration to abortion and enhancing Democratic voter turnout. Such activities have sparked controversy and legislative responses aimed at curbing foreign influence in American electoral processes.https://thefederalist.com/2024/04/18/dark-money-group-backed-by-foreign-billionaire-has-dumped-100-million-into-state-ballot-initiatives/1630 Fund is currently funding multiple ballot initiatives in Alaska, including Alaskans For Better Elections AKBE who brought Ranked Choice Voting to Alaska. Also including the recent push for a higher minimum wage. At some point, one must question when the regulators and government officials, elected to safeguard citizens, become tools manipulated by these malicious actors to act against the citizens they are meant to protect.(e.g. we have been attacked 4 times so far 3 times using state offices, we have been spied on, harassed, and our reputations damaged nationwide all because we were trying to address an election system we didn't feel was a good fit for Alaska)I hope you take this threat to your State Seriously, they are incredibly well funded and they are hell bent on making changes to the State of Alaska. This is one of those cases of too big to fail, where you will attack Alaskans and regular people, but applying these rules to a Swiss Billionaire is outside your job and expectations. As a citizen it saddens me to learn that millionaires and billionaires have more influence on a state and the way the state operates than the people who live here.Phil IzonPer State Statutes:**Sec. 15.13.068. **Overview of Netanyahu 's Speech to the Joint Session of Congress (The 4th time in his history that he has addressed Congress)**
In his historic speech, Netanyahu stressed this "clash between those that glorify death and those who sanctify life." "America and Israel Must Stand Together" as "we win and they lose". He assured the world that "we (Israel) will win." He talked about December 7, September 11 and October 7 are "**days that will live in infamy** " and recounted how 3000 Hamas terrorists butchered more than 1200 people including 39 Americans which is equivalent to Twenty September 11th attacks as these barbaric terrorists turned "heaven into hell" on the early morning of October 7th.

Two months ago Noa and three other hostages were rescued in an attack authorized by Netanyahu and when Noa was reunited with her mother who was dying from cancer and her last wish was to be reunited with her daughter.
Many other hostages attended Netanyahu's speech to Congress.
Netanyahu made a promise to the families of the hostages that "he will not rest until all of the hostages are returned home." He thanked Biden for his efforts and for being a "proud Irish American Zionist." Netanyahu praised some of the IDF soldiers in attendance and their bravery, including one soldier who did not have a car on October 7 and ran 8 miles to the front lines to fight and save lives and recounted other acts of bravery. He described the heroism for the Israeli Soldiers - "**they are undaunted and unafraid ... and they shall rise like lions of Judah and Israel**."
Netanyahu expressed the importance of the birth of the State of Israel and pledged that the sacrifices of all loved ones fighting this battle would not be in vain because "**for** **Israel - Never Again should not be an empty promise ... and NEVER AGAIN IS NOW."**
Netanyahu threaded the theme of this fight as the fight between good and evil and called out for anyone who stands with rapists, including these protestors that support this evil should be ashamed. **During the speech, there were reports of violent protests outside.**

Netanyahu made it clear that Israel's fight is America's fight and Israel's victory is America' victory over the most terrorist country in the world.

Netanyahu stressed that Iran's main war is with America and when they fight Iran, the Houthis, Hezbollah, they are fighting for America and our collective enemies who attack will pay a very heavy price. Netanyahu expressed how grateful Israel was for the military assistance from America and the co-development of some of the most sophisticated weapons in the world. He called for America to expedite the shipment of those weapons so Israel has the tools to "finish this job faster" and will destroy Hamas in a total victory.
After defeat of the terrorists, Netanyahu stressed the new Gaza would be a demilitarized zone and that Israel had no interest to conquer Gaza. He expressed hope for a civilian government with a new generation that would not want to destroy Israel. He called for a broader Middle-east security alliance against Iran, the expansion of Abraham accords the Abraham alliances.

Thank you for standing for Israel and together we shall secure a brilliant future for both of our nations.**" "May God Bless Israel, May God Bless America and May God bless the Alliance between Israel and America."

In the coming days, as I hit the campaign trail to meet with Americans and lay out the choice in front of voters in the fall, I cannot imagine two more starkly different visions for where we want our country to go.

Team —
I’ve been watching JD Vance since he became a Senator back in 2023. And I’ve been paying a good bit more attention to him over the last couple weeks now that Trump named him as his running mate.
I ran against a guy like JD in Arizona in 2022. MAGA-right, venture capitalist, backed by a shady tech billionaire out of the Silicon Valley.

We can’t let guys like that lead us. We can’t let guys like that make decisions about our lives.

So believe me when I say _I know first-hand the critical importance of having the right team and working together_ when lives are on the line.

Make no mistake. We need real change. The results of this election will are do-or-die.

**That's where you come in:**
I have hundreds of endorsements, but I don't have yours!

Would you do me a huge favor. [**endorse me by clicking here to e-sign your name**](http://links.spiritofpatriots.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=a34efda7fa194bd08eff5a147608ba8a&_e=3lRUkqM7rd1XHbj4LjQmlZ_Ceaw8CVO99m_77BVwZGHpe4JIluXSEq8MT8OGD2v7o8Hs3IXS5VmcsUM8-ZXynJ_LJuHuGV8gvYj3NFMIUCLwYhpWnlhDuj-EYr9JMBPqdJ1zLXj452VPvD7aTPCO07DSjyrVkuLXKdKr1DuAiXmusemWD_lMdMWnYSiCBi5iQGrjcD2HtSbA1r-Il_HTMSvCeAtNu0uaBhkEjFFhj6pigkXqnn1Eu5FUPy3HksNV63byF5CTgK_3UngJmZK6iD-VhTjcEAvAo9eYm40gcMHHr7ew-1hqQo-tnVnTZyMWdiIUB9ohq3kfH5yUXJqVne_J6hixWt5tQyFUhaMLPKIXNIgI5eb3ZxPT7J2YZyLtFAQBLMz6Nw0NcYI4CzLJlYu_Jt2W06OePVdEnkOSHpU%3D)?

One other Palestinian American previously served in Congress, and he has unfortunately lost multiple members of his family who were killed in Gaza during this genocide. Shamefully, our federal government is the top funder of these atrocities, as well as the top weapons provider for the Israeli military. Now we have a chance to push a new Democratic nominee for President to change course and heed the majority of the American people, who want an arms embargo and an end to their tax dollars funding apartheid and genocide. I will keep speaking up, echoing calls from courageous people across the world who have not backed down in saying: Palestinians deserve to live, and we need a ceasefire now! | Thank you for joining me in the push for Palestinian freedom and against oppression everywhere. Just last week, the world’s top court affirmed what Palestinians and human rights organizations have said for years: Israel’s government is committing the crime of apartheid. The International Court of Justice has demanded reparations for Palestinians and an end to Israel’s illegal military occupation of the West Bank, East Jerusalem, and Gaza. This is in addition to the court's earlier rulings ordering Israel’s government to stop the violence in Gaza and allow in humanitarian aid to Gaza immediately. Now countries must act to enforce these rulings, including the United States. Together, we will continue demanding and building a world that values all life equally, no matter ethnicity or background. On July 23 more than 500 Jewish Americans protested on Capitol Hill, demanding the United States end its arms sales to the Netanyahu regime.
On July 24, with the backdrop of thousands of people protesting him, Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's addressed U.S. Congress. His remarks were filled with numerous inaccuracies, misleading statements, and flat out lies. Here, we aim to quickly fact-check and debunk 10 of the most egregious falsehoods presented in his speech. His lies are destructive not only to the Palestinian people, but also to Israelis, and to Americans. If we truly believe in international rules based order and that no person is above the law, we must hold Netanyahu accountable to those same standards of international law and human rights. **Let 's Address This.**
[Share](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=2550223&post_id=146970890&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email&utm_content=share&utm_campaign=email-share&action=share&triggerShare=true&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MTQ2OTcwODkwLCJpYXQiOjE3MjE4NTU5MzksImV4cCI6MTcyNDQ0NzkzOSwiaXNzIjoicHViLTI1NTAyMjMiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.mZwQccXnv94dF1UKv7f3gCVrzORwLAbmwo5oq1dqQo0)
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/f9a99c08-1613-4b0a-8755-4d8e9b2fb978?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

Demonstrators from Jewish Voices for Peace protest in the Canon House. Photo Credit: Tierney L. Cross/Getty Images
## 1\. The Existential Threat to Israel
Netanyahu's assertion that "_never again is now_ " in the context of October 7 is deeply ironic given his own record. The International Court of Justice (ICJ) has credibly accused him of genocide, the International Criminal Court (ICC) of war crimes, and the United Nations (UN) of "extermination" of Palestinian civilians. Even former IDF Chiefs of Staff and Mossad Directors have labeled him "an existential threat to Israel," in a letter to Congressional leadership, recognizing his actions as criminal. (See 2 page letter below). It is absurd that he is given a bipartisan platform in Congress despite these accusations. In short, the biggest threat to Israel according to Israelis themselves, is Benjamin Netanyahu.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/d653292e-b3d3-410a-9c59-87d815030258?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/cf2b7cca-4998-43b5-8a95-a3e3160ddca4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
## 2\. Protests and Ceasefire
Netanyahu next claimed that those protesting for a ceasefire and the release of all hostages are "pro Hamas" and "funded by Iran." This is, of course, baseless. First of all, [Israel itself agreed to a complete ceasefire and release of all hostages](https://substack.com/redirect/29d28186-7e33-4a88-a6ee-7cce5b1bdc40?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Now, [Israel and Netanyahu reject their very own proposal](https://substack.com/redirect/f4630f55-57c2-48c8-931f-89fc89cb8f9b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)! So, on what grounds can Netanyahu condemn protestors for agreeing with him? Likewise, there is no evidence to support the assertion that the people protesting Netanyahu on the steps of Congress are "funded by Iran." This is just a bald faced lie, but making claims without evidence is Netanyahu's calling card.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/b10fc61d-39d0-4b36-b917-01f633da34fd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
_Activists participate in a pro-Palestinian protest near the U.S. Capitol on July 24, 2024 in Washington, D.C._ ALEX WONG/GETTY IMAGES
Finally, [his regime has deliberately bombed safe zones, as The New York Times and ABC news have documented, on more than 200 occasions](https://substack.com/redirect/c9ab539e-2d10-4c0d-913e-9fe1eba64989?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). This contradicts any genuine claim of adherence to humanitarian principles. Netanyahu's smear tactic diverts attention from legitimate calls for peace and human rights, and is a shameless attempt to avoid accountability.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..IXACeQjhkpPM4AFAxrGGRdWwNIBvwutLiMeFDRNufnA?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=146970890)
## 3\. Criticism of Israel and Antisemitism
Netanyahu equates criticism of Israel with antisemitism, which is a blatant lie. [I've written on this extensively before](https://substack.com/redirect/fa05881d-6f04-4fb0-b78c-0c09332ac94b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Criticizing a government's policies is not the same as hating a people. Antisemitism is the hatred of Jewish people, not the critique of the actions of the Israeli government. People have rights; governments do not. This distinction is crucial and must be understood to prevent the misuse of antisemitism accusations.
## 4\. Famine and Aid in Gaza
Netanyahu accused the ICC Prosecutor Karim Khan of antisemitism for stating that Israel is "_starving the people of Gaza_." Instead, Netanyahu claims that "_Hamas is stealing aid_." Both of these claims are lies. First, the UN has confirmed famine conditions in Gaza due to the Israeli blockade, [declaring](https://substack.com/redirect/d9c65dad-191c-4867-97fa-b789cbaf114a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg):
> We declare that Israel's intentional and targeted starvation campaign against the Palestinian people is a form of genocidal violence and has resulted in famine across all of Gaza. We call upon the international community to prioritise the delivery of humanitarian aid by land by any means necessary, end Israel's siege, and establish a ceasefire.
Moreover, back in February the [ICJ condemned Israel's food blockade and ordered the Netanyahu regime to comply to ensure aid reaches Gaza](https://substack.com/redirect/51addb58-36dc-4c16-816e-fa1c945befc4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). The regime has refused to comply.
Likewise, the U.S. government and on the ground NGOs have each reported that [Israeli settlers, tipped off by the Israeli military, are blocking aid](https://substack.com/redirect/515d71ce-cf79-41eb-86d2-70b0f2285758?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). There's literal video evidence of it happening as a common event. Meanwhile, as the US Government has also admitted, [Netanyahu has provided no evidence to substantiate his claim that Hamas is diverting aid](https://substack.com/redirect/515d71ce-cf79-41eb-86d2-70b0f2285758?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). It is pure, meritless, propaganda. Instead, as Euro-Med Human Rights Monitor documents, the actual horror inflicted upon civilians is almost incomprehensible.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/a8fc6a79-2f2f-4b75-9c4b-6c750c05bec4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

## 5\. Civilian Protection and Journalistic Freedom
Netanyahu's assertion that "_Israel has implemented more precautions than any army in history to protect civilians from harm_ " is contradicted by his actions--for example the 200+ times his regime has bombed designated safe zone where the Israeli military specifically forced civilians to go to. Despite his audacious claim that Israel has "killed practically no civilians," [The Lancet conservatively estimates that over 186,000 Palestinians have been killed by Israeli bombings](https://substack.com/redirect/e7e34f9a-8858-4e33-b970-6f059c8a4af4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Netanyahu's attempt to deny these documented deaths is an egregious lie, asking us to disbelieve the evidence before our eyes. His regime bans journalists, exiles local reporters, and [has killed over 108 journalists and media workers who were covering his military actions](https://substack.com/redirect/73b045f3-c1e3-4d1a-b29b-b34996b37078?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). His request for trust, devoid of transparency, is reckless propaganda.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/641d8fa6-77f9-486e-9f2f-b00ff15b7c76?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
## 6\. The Fight Against Hamas
Netanyahu portrays his fight against Hamas as aligned with America's interests. Perhaps this is to try and [counter the reality that](https://substack.com/redirect/9176a800-3a40-4e15-816a-ccdb8c355676?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Americans are sick of this war and, "_nearly 70% of Democrats and independents, as well as, two-thirds of Republicans favor policies that don 't send American troops to the Middle East_." And notwithstanding that Hamas is a _reaction_ to decades of illegal Israeli occupation, how can the war be against Hamas when Netanyahu himself has funded Hamas for years?
As oft reported by [The Times of Israel](https://substack.com/redirect/947a98f4-0055-4193-a144-11065f45768a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), The [New York Times](https://substack.com/redirect/bc475b83-3dd6-471f-8391-20e03c84adfc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), and a host of other outlets, Netanyahu brazenly helped fund and prop up Hamas with the explicit goal of undermining the PLO, preventing peace, and preventing a viable Palestinian state. This history of support undercuts his current stance and exposes a strategy of perpetuating conflict for political gain.
## 7\. Iran's Nuclear Program
Netanyahu cited Iran as the root of all problems in the Middle East, and the world. In particular, he claimed his siege on Gaza was necessary to protect the U.S. from Iranian nuclear threats and "radical Islam." This is a fascinating claim, given he unabashedly [encouraged and bragged about convincing former President Donald Trump to dismantle the Obama-era nuclear deal](https://substack.com/redirect/cdbcc09e-201e-4350-be3a-740228ee7b9e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), which had successfully prevented Iran from obtaining nuclear weapons. Of course, Netanyahu never has and never will bother to try and explain this contradiction, because doing so would further highlight his opportunism and dishonesty.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..IXACeQjhkpPM4AFAxrGGRdWwNIBvwutLiMeFDRNufnA?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=146970890)
## 8\. Political Violence and Hypocrisy
Netanyahu's statement that "_there is no room for political violence in democracies_ " is deeply ironic, given his credible accusations of war crimes, extermination, and genocide. [It's also hypocritical given Israeli intelligence under Netanyahu threatened and spied on the ICC](https://substack.com/redirect/53ff599d-7f41-4525-80d9-b0b91ad616a9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Throughout his speech Netanyahu repeatedly thanked Donald Trump, a man with a documented history of antisemitic and racist comments, a man who called Nazis 'very fine people,' a man who happily dined with Nazis in his own home, and [a man who has inspired countless acts of political violence](https://substack.com/redirect/bf86252c-ea59-4ab3-8182-2178d7e4a953?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). This further underscores Netanyahu's hypocrisy and lack of integrity.
## 9\. The Two-State Solution
Netanyahu's failure to mention a genuine two-state solution where Palestinians have self-determination speaks volumes. His vision for Gaza involves disarmament and a lack of autonomy, which no nation would accept for itself. In fact, for the first time in history the [Israeli parliament just passed a resolution opposing a two state solution](https://substack.com/redirect/3dc04053-b557-402f-b9a5-44f732527c03?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Likewise, [Netanyahu is on record that he will never allow an independent Palestinian state](https://substack.com/redirect/1bd29f90-7a0c-4af5-a371-dcada7dbb431?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Israeli leadership has gone as far as to say it is ready [to annex the West Bank](https://substack.com/redirect/cc9495a6-10af-4034-a976-a564855444c5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). And Israel and continues to build illegal settlements [even as the ICJ calls it apartheid and illegal while mandating removal](https://substack.com/redirect/3f8671b4-3cda-4d20-9287-e6899166f274?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Given this, it does not take a genius to realize that Netanyahu's siege on Gaza has little to do with justice, and everything to do with expanding power and control over Palestinian land.
## 10\. Democratic Boycott
While Netanyahu claimed that his support with America is unbreakable, clear breaks are forming. One of the most telling indicators of Netanyahu's declining influence is the growing boycott of his speeches by Democrats in Congress. In 2015, about 50 Democrats boycotted his speech. Today, that number rose to 136. This shift signals a significant loss of support for Netanyahu within the Democratic Party. On notable Democrat who attended, did so to send a message, and it was a message read loud and clear.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/21b5ead6-69b5-4204-8185-1b2a952c6b5b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Congresswoman Rashid Tlaib of Michigan attended Netanyahu's speech while holding a sign calling Netanyahu a war criminal.

## Conclusion
Netanyahu's speech was a despicable masterclass in misinformation. It echoed the Trumpian tactic of overwhelming audiences with falsehoods in hopes of creating exhaustion and apathy. He is desperate to deflect attention from his failed policies and put the blame on others. The American public and policymakers must instead see through this propaganda and hold him accountable. Netanyahu is no friend to the American people, or to the causes of global peace and justice. As he now pushes for war with Iran, [recall his incitement to encourage the United States to invade Iraq](https://substack.com/redirect/4d365669-aa75-4f19-b001-141f64cfd247?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), and the horrific consequences of that decision. Someone who has been so wrong for so long should not ever be trusted again, and certainly not now.
In her run for the White House, VP Harris has an opportunity to turn the page on a failed U.S. policy on Israel and Palestine. She can do so by upholding US Leahy Laws, international human rights law, and the will of the American people. Stop funding Netanyahu, start rebuilding Gaza, and condition aid on a complete ceasefire, release of all hostages on both sides, a withdrawal from Gaza and the West Bank, and an independent Palestinian state. That is the path towards peace and security for both Palestine and Israel.

Through his relentless work ethic and untamable entrepreneurial spirit, he turned the first car dealership that he purchased in 2005 into one of the largest dealership groups in America.

# Host Committee Happenings
A Newsletter by the Chicago 2024 Host Committee
---
|
---
|
## Note from The Host Committee
---
| The Host Committee is profoundly grateful President Biden selected Chicago to host the 2024 Democratic National Convention. Our city has a proven track record of success when it comes to hosting large-scale, complex events. Chicago has hosted 25 nominating conventions since 1860––more than any other city in America––and we look forward to welcoming visitors from around the world to our 26th convention next month. The Host Committee’s commitment to creating a world-class experience for all attendees and residents remains unchanged, and we are laser-focused on our goal of driving lasting social and economic impact across the Chicagoland area.
---
| | | | | | | | | | | We are only **26** days away from the Democratic National Convention!
Did you know that Chicago has **26** miles of open and free lakefront?
---
|
---
|
---
|
## Volunteer Update
---
| We are excited to announce we have surpassed our goal of **15,000** volunteer applications! Individuals who applied on or before **July 5th** will have priority access to shift sign ups. Individuals who applied after the 5th will be able to access shifts shortly after.
Be on the lookout for more information in the coming days about the first batch of volunteer opportunities and how to access them. We appreciate your enthusiasm for what promises to be an exciting and historic convention!
If you are still interested in volunteering and have not filled out an application, you can sign up [here](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=1b45118ee5&e=e789b9d47e) to join a waiting list. Prospective applicants on the waiting list will be notified if shifts become available.
---
|
---

## City Club of Chicago Countdown to DNC Panel

## Chicago-Area Events Ahead of The DNC
---
| August is packed with thrilling events in Chicago. [Lollapalooza](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=1bdeecfe92&e=e789b9d47e), [The Bud Biliken Parade](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=e3c007b59d&e=e789b9d47e), [The Chicago Air and Water Show](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=3bc28b3108&e=e789b9d47e), and [more](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=fdd76b4d56&e=e789b9d47e) all occur during the month of the DNC. | **Natalie Edelstein Jarvis** , Director of Communication for the Host Committee and **Emily Soong** , Press Secretary for the Democratic National Convention Committee met with CAN-TV’s**Hugo Balta** to talk about security, volunteers, and the economic impact of the DNC.

## DNC Brings Business Opportunities to Chicago Vendors
---
| August’s convention will be powered by hundreds of diverse, local vendors—each with their own story to tell! Our vendor directory features over **2,800** small businesses that are connecting Chicago's small business community with the tens of thousands of visitors coming into town next month.
If you're planning a meeting or event during the convention, you can find your next venue, caterer, decorator, or vendor using the Vendor Directory!
If you're a vendor, but not in the directory yet, don't miss out on this chance to put your business in the spotlight! Complete the [Vendor Interest Form](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=99388f8626&e=e789b9d47e) and our team will carefully review your submission and add your business to the[ Vendor Directory](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=2068398541&e=e789b9d47e) or[ Venue Map](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=00be00bf14&e=e789b9d47e). Don't miss out - submit the form today!
For questions about vendors, please email [vendors@chicago2024.com](mailto:vendors@chicago2024.com), and for venue inquiries, please email [venues@chicago2024.com](mailto:venues@chicago2024.com).
---
|
---
|
## Chicago Convention Trivia
---
| Thank you to all who answered last edition’s question. **New York City** was a finalist for hosting the DNC in both 1996 and 2024, losing out to Chicago.
Congratulations to **Carl Fisher** , a convention delegate from Oregon, for being the first to correctly respond.
**This week’s question:** Which year was the first nationally televised political nominating convention?
Email [press@chicago2024.com](mailto:press@chicago2024.com?subject=Convention%20Trivia%20Answer&body=null) with your answer.

|
---
|
## 77 Spotlight
---
| | | | | | | | | | | This week we are spotlighting neighborhoods in Chicago’s far southwest side.
**Back of the Yards** , formerly housed the Union Stock Yards and was the U.S. hub for the meatpacking industry!
---
| | | | | | | | | | | 🛍️ [Swap-O-Rama](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=a24c0436dd&e=e789b9d47e), the oldest flea market in Chicago, averages 25,000 visitors and 500 sellers on weekends.
🥛 Brewed in Back of the Yards, [Kombuchade+](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=68987ffbc5&e=e789b9d47e) is a performance-focused kombucha made with electrolytes for athletes! Check out their amazing flavors!
---
|
---
| _📷 Eater Chicago_
---
| ☕ [Sputnik Coffee](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=c50ccbffec&e=e789b9d47e) offers both adorable and delicious coffee made with Arabica beans from Brazil, Colombia, and Indonesia!
---
| | | | | | | | | | | **Bridgeport** , home to the [Chicago White Sox](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=aeb18d0841&e=e789b9d47e), was birthed through the development of the Illinois and Michigan Canal by Irish workers.
🌮[Antique Taco](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=c674e0c606&e=e789b9d47e), a family run business since 2012, serves a variety of tacos with homemade corn tortillas! Also known for their horchata milkshake and guava cupcakes!
---
|
---
| 📷 _Wikimedia Commons_
---
| | | | | | | | | | | 🎨 [Bridgeport Art Center](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=8b63d57672&e=e789b9d47e) holds the Chicago Maritime Museum, Base Cafe, portrays a different exhibition each month and offers ceramics classes.
🦆 Located in a pre-Prohibition tavern, [The Duck Inn](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=1af0e38c4c&e=e789b9d47e) offers their signature rotisserie duck and duck inn hot dog!
---
|
---
|
## Vendor Spotlights
---
| [Tzuco](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=6ddc23eeeb&e=e789b9d47e), a Michelin-star and sister-restaurant to [Ummo](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=c47f466cda&e=e789b9d47e), takes a creative twist on traditional Mexican food. Serving up everything from tetelas and costillas de res for dinner and carne asada huarache and chorizo crepes for brunch. Not to mention, their signature drinks include the mexique sangría, michelada cubana, and an horchata latte martini! You find Tzuco in the[ DNC Vendor Directory](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=81c070e80f&e=e789b9d47e).
---
| | | | | | | | | |
---
| | [Ummo ](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=7217c0b82a&e=e789b9d47e)is known for contemporary Italian food with a blend of American. Located in River North, serves a variety of housemade pasta, pollo rosso, brazino arrosto, and burrata e avocado. After restaurant hours, Ummo’s second floor transforms into Loft 22, a lounge offering cocktails and live music in a cozy space. You can find Ummo in the [DNC Vendor Directory](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=bd16cd2166&e=e789b9d47e).
---

|
---
|
## Staff Spotlight
---
| This week’s staff spotlight is our Labor Advisor, **Nora Cay Ryan**!
---
| | | | | | | | | |
---
| | Nora was raised in the northwest suburbs of Illinois, and currently lives in**Lakeshore East**. She chose to work for the Host Committee because Chicago’s workforce plays an important role for the best city in the world. She wants to help showcase Chicago’s union labor ability to put on the greatest, most inclusive convention ever!
Her favorite local restaurant is [Remington’s](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=fa9da69cc3&e=e789b9d47e) on Michigan Avenue. In her free time, Nora likes to play golf and binge watch the latest shows on Netflix.

body:
[1]Justice Democrats

60 percent, Peter.

Under Wesley Bell’s leadership, there are 60% more Black women behind bars
in St. Louis County today than there were a year ago.

Bell is the dark-money-funded prosecutor challenging Rep. Cori Bush in
Missouri’s 1st congressional district. And we’ve got a question for him:

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20240724-cb.Cpn0u3&refcode=em20240724-35818&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1001&akid=35818%2E1203867%2EUQsFud ]Justice Democrats: If Wesley Bell can’t keep his promises at the county
level, why should anyone believe he will in Congress? NPR headline: Report
from racial justice groups says Wesley Bell’s office has not kept its
promises.

A new report has found that Wesley Bell failed to live up to the
progressive promises he made in the past on the campaign trail. [ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20240724-cb.Cpn0u3&refcode=em20240724-35818&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1002&akid=35818%2E1203867%2EUQsFud ]Can you
split a donation between Cori’s campaign and Justice Democrats right now
to make sure he doesn’t replace Cori in Congress and continue to break his
promises to the people?

Under Bell’s leadership, the St. Louis County jail population has
increased 23% in the past year and 46% in the past two years — even as the
national jail and prison population fell by over 10% during the same
period.

His office failed to respond to almost a dozen requests for data,
including questions about whether his office employs a lobbyist, maintains
a police officer exclusion list, has made efforts to curb pretrial
detention, seeks the death penalty, has a record of criminalizing
protestors, and more.

Wesley Bell ran as a reformer who would address the systemic injustices
that plague our legal system. But as a prosecutor, he has done the
opposite, overseeing the steady climb of St. Louis County’s jail
population. Now, he’s making a whole new set of promises to defeat Cori
and get elected to Congress — but we know he won’t keep them.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20240724-cb.Cpn0u3&refcode=em20240724-35818&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1003&akid=35818%2E1203867%2EUQsFud ]We have less than two weeks to stop Bell and re-elect Cori. Split
$5 between her campaign and Justice Democrats now to make
sure Bell and his broken promises don’t make it to Congress.

Peter, before
he became a prosecutor, Wesley Bell worked for an anti-abortion
Republican. Now, he’s promising to defend reproductive freedom in
Congress. Do we really believe him?

Cori Bush keeps her promises. Let’s get her re-elected.

In solidarity,

Justice Democrats

As a woman running for office, I’m on the receiving end of sexist comments and absurd questions. But the ignorance will never slow me down. Frankly, it serves as fuel for the fight.

Now, with 6 days until our primary Election Day, the attacks are ramping up. Our opponents know that I’m the **_only_** candidate who has what it takes to defeat MAGA David Schweikert in November – and we’re seeing attack after attack launched at us.

**I am undeterred. There is too much at stake to back down.**

Abortion rights are on the ballot. Democracy is on the ballot. AZ-01 deserves a fearless leader, not someone who puts far-right policies ahead of our best interests like Schweikert.

Democracy runs through AZ-01. Whoever wins this race in November could decide House control and our district could very well decide the presidency here in Arizona.

#

This week, the NRA posted an article gushing about Donald Trump’s running mate, JD Vance:

Let’s take a look at some of the things they talk about in this article:
* They tout that Vance proudly voted against the _Bipartisan Safer Communities Act_ —the most significant gun safety legislation passed in nearly 30 years. The NRA dubbed it as a “gun control monstrosity.”

* They also brag about Vance voting to overturn the ATF’s rule to regulate stabilizing braces, which are devices that essentially turn semi-automatic pistols into short-barrelled rifles.

* They delight in the fact that Vance opposes universal background checks.

Just like Donald Trump, JD Vance is deep in the gun lobby’s pocket. If we allow them to take back the White House, countless lives will be in jeopardy.

| Peter,

When I look around and see what’s happening in New Hampshire and across the country, I see extreme politicians and judges attacking our most fundamental freedoms and threatening the future of our democracy.

Growing up in New Hampshire made me the person I am today and taught me that democracy isn't something you watch from the sidelines - _it’s something you participate in._

I’ve dedicated my career to defending democracy at home and abroad, from serving as an intelligence officer in the United States Navy and a lawyer in the first impeachment trial of former President Donald Trump to teaching constitutional law at the University of New Hampshire and Dartmouth, to fighting for voting rights as a lawyer with the New Hampshire Campaign for Voting Rights.

On day one, I’m ready to be a relentless champion for voting rights, campaign finance reform, fair maps, and other critical reforms to ensure accountability across our federal government. Our democracy depends on a government that works for We the People.

body:
Wisconsin is the center of the political universe. And Kamala Harris knows the road to the White House runs through Wisconsin.

logo

If it wasn’t already clear, the last week has proven that Wisconsin is the center of the political universe in 2024.

Last week, the Republican National Convention was held in Milwaukee.

And yesterday, Kamala Harris came to Milwaukee.

** What should you know about Kamala Harris?

* She was rated the country’s most liberal Senator by the nonpartisan group GovTrack.

** What else should you know about Kamala Harris?
------------------------------------------------------------

**

She knows the road to the White House runs through Wisconsin.

We are 103 days away from Election Day. And it’s going to take all hands on deck to ensure Republicans keep control of the House, take back the Senate, and send President Trump back to the White House.

With less than two months until our primary election, it’s been a busy time.
But there are a few things I love more than coffee and campaigning. So today, I wanted to go through my camera roll and share some of my favorite moments from the past few weeks with you! 📸
Before I do, I have to ask: [**Can you pitch in $5 to support our campaign today? Like I said earlier, our primary is coming up quickly, and a little bit goes a long way in a small state like Delaware!**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20240724-1?refcode=em20240724-1-869&refcode2=869_21716_i8W3C2&akid=869%2E21716%2Ei8W3C2)
Ok, first up:
I started off a hot, but wonderful **Fourth of July** with the annual Smyrna-Clayton Fourth of July Parade! But I didn’t stop there — I also made stops in Hockessin, Dover, and Wilmington to celebrate Independence Day with our neighbors.
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20240724-1?refcode=em20240724-1-869&refcode2=869_21716_i8W3C2&akid=869%2E21716%2Ei8W3C2)
Next, our campaign hit a BIG milestone: **we knocked on our 10,000th door!** I am truly in awe and so grateful to our incredible volunteers, supporters, and staff for all their hard work. Listening and having conversations with our neighbors about the issues facing our state is the foundation of the campaign.
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20240724-1?refcode=em20240724-1&refcode2=869_21716_i8W3C2&akid=869%2E21716%2Ei8W3C2)
Then, I had the pleasure of joining the 8th, 9th, and 18th Democratic RDs to see some old friends and new faces, share our vision for Delaware, and hear about what’s top of mind for these dedicated Delaware Democrats. **Together, we’ll elect effective and proven Democrats up and down the ballot this fall!**
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20240724-1?refcode=em20240724-1-869&refcode2=869_21716_i8W3C2&akid=869%2E21716%2Ei8W3C2)
_Hey now, hey now_ 🎵It’s a running joke in our office that “What Dreams Are Made Of” from the Lizzie McGuire movie is our campaign anthem because it’s been stuck in my head for the last 20 years. 😂 **This poster is a delightful addition to our already impressive office decor!**
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20240724-1?refcode=em20240724-1&refcode2=869_21716_i8W3C2&akid=869%2E21716%2Ei8W3C2)
Last, but not least, I was so excited to visit **Millsboro** for our joint meet-and-greet with my friend — and the Democratic nominee for the 41st State House District — Tom Brett! **Together, we're going to elect collaborative and dedicated Delaware Democrats up and down our state, including in Sussex County.**
[****](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20240724-1?refcode=em20240724-1&refcode2=869_21716_i8W3C2&akid=869%2E21716%2Ei8W3C2)
I’m SO proud of the campaign we’re building, a campaign rooted in compassion, joy, and community. And the truth is that YOU make this campaign possible. **Your grassroots contributions (from emails just like this one!) keep me on the road, earning votes up and down Delaware.**
[**So, can you pitch in whatever you can spare to power our campaign events, voter outreach, and more?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20240724-1?refcode=em20240724-1-869&refcode2=869_21716_i8W3C2&akid=869%2E21716%2Ei8W3C2)
**[Donate $5 »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20240724-1?amount=5&refcode=em20240724-1-869&refcode2=869_21716_i8W3C2&akid=869%2E21716%2Ei8W3C2)**
Thank you,
Sarah McBride
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20240724-1?refcode=em20240724-1&refcode2=869_21716_i8W3C2&akid=869%2E21716%2Ei8W3C2)

Peter,

I am in full savage mode this week because the American people deserve answers!

You sent me to DC to fight for you. To fight for this nation. _And that is exactly what I am doing._ I refuse to sit silently while Director Cheatle is full of SH**!

I got her to admit the "colossal failure" of the Secret Service AND that the assassination attempt "was preventable".

_**And then I introduced a privileged motion to impeach Secret Service Director Kim Cheatle.**_ We have NEVER voted on an impeachment of an inferior civil officer... _but historic times call for historic measures._

To all my colleagues who just sit around and wait for the party to tell them what to do... [**take out your pencils and take some notes... this is how it's done.**](http://links.standingstrongamerica.com/u/click?_t=29c3b6e742c849fabbcc130432510e66&_m=4febc138b86f441680ad32215d0dd6a8&_e=AY052Sf4Kw2nTZv1OoRJ6J9B0y9I3lwjitXXYQ-BMiRL35HhIZGwoW1-oJbK-sbIrjo1JP0pFXz9C8HoXFee59qdIrm66vfrj52G-6rcilEBMrmXY6mX6neH01e3d4NqnLN1ywjB2xpH2wmaPt2MbVc2vyRFoo1BgG1M1sdxGrMFTzAFGrqqW_O-00_LL_E1FymWuKtgpaxlrRqEMh55dIl7URsty20feBjQkivxz1I3Ilm8stVgTsDiobcxRnQt5Z4W1eDn9sM400NsyWsB79KIDZBxxewaNVlUm7AbItHAbFuOI0Rz7TmoOXdAhlmdHzuRDIFMxJtGalNaBsWn0DjpIUQmgfy9aFmittUq5VMQej2Qy2-oFbkfYMK6FTB1T2wly9drGibIXDun6oKZF_f8aFiFo1S1nfm_wv9zUvo%3D)

But that's just the problem, Peter, the establishment in DC doesn't like when I call out their bull****.

Over $7 million was spent against me in the primary. _**We still won by 30 points because I refuse to stop fighting for the American people.**_

Now they're preparing to spend tens of millions against me, to shut me up. To stop me from putting a magnifying glass on everything.

**_I didn't come to play though._**

_**" Blessed is the man who remains steadfast under trial, for when he has stood the test he will receive the crown of life, which God has promised to those who love him."
James 1:12**_
Patriot,

Forty years ago, a sudden accident changed my life forever: while out for a jog one summer, a tree fell on me and left me partially paralyzed.

The Scripture passage James 1:12, among many others, got me through the most difficult season of my life. I had faith in God, and I knew he had a plan for me.

I often say our lives are not defined by the challenges we encounter but our response to those challenges.

_**This rings true for our state and its people, too. **_

Due to federal inaction to secure the Texas-Mexico border, our state has taken unprecedented action to defend our sovereign border through Operation Lone Star. body:
Once the Democrat Convention is over, the Left will launch the most vicious, dishonest political campaign in history. | | |
---
|
---
Fellow Conservative: The big story from the Republican National Convention is how _**UNITED**_ the GOP is. Meanwhile, the Democrats — who have _**DIVIDED**_ the country for years — are now tearing themselves apart.

Republicans have not gone into a national election with more momentum since Ronald Reagan, which is why conservatives must be **_ready for the dirty tricks_** we know are coming.

The Left knows what a unified, conservative GOP will achieve with Donald Trump back in the White House — border security, election integrity, lower taxes, energy dominance, and de-funded politicized bureaucracies.

However, the Left also knows they can _**BLOCK**_ this agenda if they keep control of the _**U.S. SENATE**_. That’s why they won't allow Republicans to flip the Senate without a fight. Once the Democrat Convention is over, the Left will launch the most vicious, dishonest political campaign in history.

**Very soon, the Left’s billions, media bias, and weaponized institutions will target conservative Senate candidates.**

They are coming for our team — **Ted Cruz** (TX), **Rick Scott** (FL), **Josh Hawley** (MO), **Bernie Moreno** (OH), **Kari Lake** (AZ), **Sam Brown** (NV), **Tim Sheehy** (MT), and **Eric Hovde** (WI).

We've sent a number of fundraising emails since President Biden announced he would no longer be seeking reelection
---
We've sent a number of fundraising emails since President Biden announced he would no longer be seeking reelection, so we thought it important to take a moment to explain where we're at, but also to talk about why these messages are so important. First, it has been an unprecedented month in American politics and it has never been more important for Democrats to remain united in the cause of saving our democracy and advancing an agenda that improves the lives of working people in this country. As you read this, almost every poll shows the presidential race will be close, the Senate is completely up for grabs and the House of Representatives is as well. At this point, just about anything can happen on election night. At the same time, the Trump campaign and the RNC have raised extraordinary sums of money, Republican super PACs are running ads in almost every contested state, and we're sure the worst attacks are yet to come. Back to these messages and why they are so important. You know by now that the DNC is the one organization best positioned to move resources where they need them when they are needed. It is what we do. But what you may not know is that there is no greater single source of donations making that possible than the response to emails like this. So while you may not have opened this email expecting to donate, given the current reality and how effectively we can put your contribution to work, that is what we are asking you to do: [**Can Democrats running for office everywhere count on you to contribute $7 to the Democratic National Committee today? Hi there – We’ve had a pretty busy week in politics, and Monday was no exception. (Now former) Secret Service Director Kimberly Cheatle appeared in front of the House Oversight Committee to answer questions about the assassination attempt against President Trump. Director Cheatle’s answers were anything but sufficient. She refused to take accountability for the security oversight that day, and has since resigned. It’s important that there’s accountability in our country – even in politics. We cannot be the country that gives safe harbor to domestic terrorists, and we mustn't allow our politics to inspire acts of violence. I’m proud that the House Oversight Committee conducted fast, but thorough work on this matter. It serves as an important reminder that we can disagree on policy and substance, but that’s also where it ends. Thanks for taking the time to read. \- Jared

Folks, I wanted to write to you today about something very personal to me: Planned Parenthood and reproductive rights. | | | [](http://links.mullenformontana.com/u/click?_t=96962950e68f455895e83c6431fce0d7&_m=b3bf3fdcafe74bc99b8c4915f42529bd&_e=08ZAPnSJre95Ngzxjsc3eL6uRXtk1vMuDLBQ2UCvCtoaQjTdHS8V__kS3t1SI6RtoNTkJkIFFqI7FSpi_1YJLLPMkaXhGB7016a-7-bWuPpMwmAviEuyQfsPJ3uW25em_-YUZjeekivwRwoZyeHqL2yCBVEznxUes0DG4695kdtzFaabxcc6Owr0fghmnJeXrCEYcjCV71y2BX_hdJtPvKpAb_0mAicMlJ5BmG1LpRYi5gHzesbK7EgYJ55hJJ2aT_E92FHXcw3vzHxnIE2-E2sTKseSVtWu3dijpE0xbHnvvZnBqdXn04gnyJSfaNVkRovTlD5Zqst_s0Mh2d-aF4vsRzv0DTKENIcmafnNU3rG-N7Veb8dY6z37mhbEDF973pG_7th84oxypDeetH6iQ%3D%3D) Folks, I wanted to write to you today about something very personal to me: Planned Parenthood and reproductive rights. My oldest daughter is 20. Had she been born a couple weeks earlier, I’d have been a teen dad. I was a college freshman when my girlfriend told me she thought she was pregnant. We were terrified – to tell our parents, and about what it meant for our future. I worked a few hours a week at the college library while attending school full time and she waitressed at the Chuckwagon, an old, greasy spoon off I-80 popular with truckers and the hungover student crowd. We were broke, inexperienced, scared, so we went to Planned Parenthood. We discovered yes, she was pregnant, and then we learned about ALL of the resources available. It was an eye-opening experience, and one that I’m forever grateful for, because it showed us a path forward to have Emily, our oldest daughter. We named her after my little sister, Emily, who passed away young. Life continues, and the resources we needed then, from Planned Parenthood to Head Start came under attack. But people like us fought back, and ensured they remained available to future generations. As my business grew and I no longer needed those resources, I promised to do what I could to protect that safety net for future generations. I didn’t know 16 years later, my daughter would need Planned Parenthood, much like her mother and I had. I drove my daughter to Planned Parenthood of Great Falls, past picketing protesters, walked her to the building, helped complete the paperwork and sat in a waiting room while she had a similar discussion to the one her mother and I had 16 years earlier. On the quiet three-hour drive home, Emily let me know she was planning to keep the baby, my grandson, Oliver. [](http://links.mullenformontana.com/u/click?_t=96962950e68f455895e83c6431fce0d7&_m=b3bf3fdcafe74bc99b8c4915f42529bd&_e=08ZAPnSJre95Ngzxjsc3eL6uRXtk1vMuDLBQ2UCvCtoaQjTdHS8V__kS3t1SI6RtoNTkJkIFFqI7FSpi_1YJLLPMkaXhGB7016a-7-bWuPpMwmAviEuyQfsPJ3uW25em_-YUZjeekivwRwoZyeHqL2yCBVEznxUes0DG4695kdtzFaabxcc6Owr0fghmnJeXrCEYcjCV71y2BX_hdJtPvKpAb_0mAicMlJ5BmG1LpRYi5gHzesbK7EgYJ55hJJ2aVYjQehmyF5iyuUlXpcLsHUdtvKr3JsgZ1XVB9ZpaKBnYP1WBNXU_pOAcYyhY5bwZo-Ov5tMdWkxCav6hRS33Rvz9MDf5tR_k_Xbp3y8DtOKsgeEUQZuWhfHoEAlsx6pNDGsoJJ7zjxFVCqqj_qExyQ%3D%3D) Because of the safety net that was available to me when I was young, I had resources to support my daughter. I changed my schedule to work primarily from home to watch my grandson while she graduated from high school on time and became Powell County High School’s first-ever Hilleman Scholar at Montana State University. My daughter had a choice. Her mother had a choice. They were able to make their choices because they were fully aware of what support was and was not available to them. My opponent wants to take that choice away from my daughters, and yours. Please let us know that you won’t let that stand. [**I’m asking 1,000 of our supporters to add their name to our petition demanding that Planned Parenthood be protected in our state.**](http://links.mullenformontana.com/u/click?_t=96962950e68f455895e83c6431fce0d7&_m=b3bf3fdcafe74bc99b8c4915f42529bd&_e=08ZAPnSJre95Ngzxjsc3eLrO59pAjxp98aXPcrlOSta9xl4M0RkKA-kM7iem_8np4BEWm98_fkaHC3g4JYvQfw8j_qKzzfsz92RoC4pjs6-W_oRv-oojWADp2RPPl27cKyVjwlf92DhvwAZIXZ4PczPy9DQYCf3HprYYWatfAxYRGhsIeqYhGD2OJiXBBzMLAImlg86TgOAAYuUUuSetjXYc0PfnTMMccPlJS-i-JEAGWWnmCj3Rv9hfA1P_gkbjdSyKPH2V32KBOOxp6aDSBTaIhH28Y2T9U-CfAyrV2wr8KIImzbT3WM0bNcdqtQWB) [ADD YOUR NAME](http://links.mullenformontana.com/u/click?_t=96962950e68f455895e83c6431fce0d7&_m=b3bf3fdcafe74bc99b8c4915f42529bd&_e=08ZAPnSJre95Ngzxjsc3eLrO59pAjxp98aXPcrlOSta9xl4M0RkKA-kM7iem_8np4BEWm98_fkaHC3g4JYvQfw8j_qKzzfsz92RoC4pjs6-W_oRv-oojWADp2RPPl27cKyVjwlf92DhvwAZIXZ4Pc8WOA0oYb5dKPt9P1--4sYaPu4Ln2jO9qX_AqfVFzX4YJZiyCcmKY6K7z3m4CXSkZI_fEDsiOiPzTwTJ_F3diQtDPdLiqKxSN0XMJUSFR8gvsJ2h-UaPcNbhdXUDzGrKtv5EjA2RNNnf4rriOCtwVghG2x91_OFGSrOLWN-oECK9) In November, Montana voters will decide whether or not the right to reproductive health care will be codified as state law. **My opponent, Christi Jacobsen, wants that effort to fail – and for purely political reasons she has tried to purge thousands of voters from our rolls to swing the results.** This is cynicism at its worst, and it has no place in the office of the Secretary of State. [**So I’m asking you to show your support for reproductive rights and Planned Parenthood by signing onto our petition today.**](http://links.mullenformontana.com/u/click?_t=96962950e68f455895e83c6431fce0d7&_m=b3bf3fdcafe74bc99b8c4915f42529bd&_e=08ZAPnSJre95Ngzxjsc3eLrO59pAjxp98aXPcrlOSta9xl4M0RkKA-kM7iem_8np4BEWm98_fkaHC3g4JYvQfw8j_qKzzfsz92RoC4pjs6-W_oRv-oojWADp2RPPl27cKyVjwlf92DhvwAZIXZ4Pc1PfBNqFLuATTSpKTQANpcrrNRVlxv2kWf8FKuoKmG23nkexIzoLFzWxqJ7LpPXIqUbe1SxRMLg6qZtdMi_bgWQNlgCQXS1cot5fF2UemUbMAgwUdXRAFqFcXlD5-XUCwQ3F8NvGCzPAwOupJoL_U6CLmbAYNtKWD3_7e3QKoZwm) [ADD YOUR NAME](http://links.mullenformontana.com/u/click?_t=96962950e68f455895e83c6431fce0d7&_m=b3bf3fdcafe74bc99b8c4915f42529bd&_e=08ZAPnSJre95Ngzxjsc3eLrO59pAjxp98aXPcrlOSta9xl4M0RkKA-kM7iem_8np4BEWm98_fkaHC3g4JYvQfw8j_qKzzfsz92RoC4pjs6-W_oRv-oojWADp2RPPl27cKyVjwlf92DhvwAZIXZ4Pc_QMaB0uyV3qizHVBwllUNSNMsDAbYpxsR712-ev5aoKoTYEhtMhTc3CdLLgIVVZ42t3kGzjFVeszDKErTUg41cbsJxklMNUUIAAbO5W1BNzcUzLjyJn_chUySSXON-Dmq2ospf2TW112CIaLJFFOtC6c8HYvEeyz3ystlrRnDJn) Thank you,
Jesse James Mullen

clean_body: Folks, I wanted to write to you today about something very personal to me: Planned Parenthood and reproductive rights. | | | Folks, I wanted to write to you today about something very personal to me: Planned Parenthood and reproductive rights. My oldest daughter is 20. Had she been born a couple weeks earlier, I’d have been a teen dad. I was a college freshman when my girlfriend told me she thought she was pregnant. We were terrified – to tell our parents, and about what it meant for our future. I worked a few hours a week at the college library while attending school full time and she waitressed at the Chuckwagon, an old, greasy spoon off I-80 popular with truckers and the hungover student crowd. We were broke, inexperienced, scared, so we went to Planned Parenthood. We discovered yes, she was pregnant, and then we learned about ALL of the resources available. It was an eye-opening experience, and one that I’m forever grateful for, because it showed us a path forward to have Emily, our oldest daughter. We named her after my little sister, Emily, who passed away young. Life continues, and the resources we needed then, from Planned Parenthood to Head Start came under attack. But people like us fought back, and ensured they remained available to future generations. As my business grew and I no longer needed those resources, I promised to do what I could to protect that safety net for future generations. I didn’t know 16 years later, my daughter would need Planned Parenthood, much like her mother and I had. I drove my daughter to Planned Parenthood of Great Falls, past picketing protesters, walked her to the building, helped complete the paperwork and sat in a waiting room while she had a similar discussion to the one her mother and I had 16 years earlier. On the quiet three-hour drive home, Emily let me know she was planning to keep the baby, my grandson, Oliver. Because of the safety net that was available to me when I was young, I had resources to support my daughter. I changed my schedule to work primarily from home to watch my grandson while she graduated from high school on time and became Powell County High School’s first-ever Hilleman Scholar at Montana State University. My daughter had a choice. Her mother had a choice. They were able to make their choices because they were fully aware of what support was and was not available to them. My opponent wants to take that choice away from my daughters, and yours. Please let us know that you won’t let that stand. In November, Montana voters will decide whether or not the right to reproductive health care will be codified as state law. My opponent, Christi Jacobsen, wants that effort to fail – and for purely political reasons she has tried to purge thousands of voters from our rolls to swing the results. This is cynicism at its worst, and it has no place in the office of the Secretary of State. Thank you, Jesse James Mullen Montana needs your help to defeat the Far Right and protect our values of caring, community, and free and fair Elections. Your donation will protect election integrity, and public land access and build a friendlier secretary of state office for Montanans! Paid for by Mullen For Secretary of State
