name: Sara Jacobs
subject: Joe Biden and Kamala Harris
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Sara Jacobs for Congress
body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em]
President Biden took office in 2021 to heal our nation, restore hope, and rebuild democracy – and he has done that, and so much more.
What he has accomplished in the past three and a half years has been incredible.
From the American Rescue Plan, to the Bipartisan Infrastructure Law, to the CHIPS Act, to appointing Justice Ketanji Brown Jackson to the U.S. Supreme Court, to the Bipartisan Safer Communities Act. From more than 15 million jobs created, to record-low child poverty, to trillions in new household wealth.
He’s signed executive orders that take action to prevent gun violence, to combat anti-LGBTQ laws passed in states across the country, and to expand and protect access to abortion and reproductive care.
All of these accomplishments have had a massive impact on the American people, changing our lives for the better not only now, but for generations to come.
And through it all – his career in the Senate, his service as Vice President beside President Obama, his historically progressive Administration, and his decision yesterday – President Biden has reminded us all what it is to be patriotic, and what it is to be a public servant.
I met Joe Biden when I was working on the 2012 re-election campaign for President Obama and then-Vice President Biden.
It was a hectic time – as the campaign trail always is. But no matter how many people he had to talk to or how busy his day was, he always had time for a smile and a kind word for all of us who were working for him.
My own career in public service has been influenced and inspired by his leadership and his belief in the goodness of his fellow Americans.
As we all come together to thank President Biden for his lifetime of service and contributions to our country’s progress, we’re also coming together in support of Vice President Kamala Harris.
Kamala is a leader who can unite our party, defeat Donald Trump, and continue delivering wins for the American people. I’m so proud to be all in for Kamala, and today I’m hoping you’ll join me.
Donate any amount right now, split between my re-election campaign and Kamala Harris’s campaign for President, and let’s get ready to win big in November. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em-kamala]
This is a pivotal moment for our party and our country, and I’m grateful to have two amazing leaders in President Biden and Vice President Harris at the helm.
I can’t wait to work alongside my fellow Democrats – and fellow Californian Kamala Harris – to secure Democratic wins in just 104 days!
Sincerely,
Sara Jacobs

Our momentum is growing. Want to join us?
# [](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/852?refcode=em20240724-2&t=1&akid=984%2E587540%2EeMAsw5)
Peter,
**Leaders We Deserve and our co-founders, David Hogg and Kevin Lata, just got featured in _Fast Company_ for the work we’re doing to elect more young people:**
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwd-em-20240724-2?refcode=em20240724-2&refcode2=984_587540_eMAsw5&akid=984%2E587540%2EeMAsw5)
**[Can we count on you to join this movement to support the next generation of bold, progressive leadership? Donate $5 right now to power our work>>>](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwd-em-20240724-2?refcode=em20240724-2&amount=5&refcode2=984_587540_eMAsw5&akid=984%2E587540%2EeMAsw5)**
The _Fast Company_ article covered a lot of ground, but here are some highlights:
* After surviving a school shooting at his high school in Parkland, Florida, David Hogg helped launch a student-led non-profit, March for Our Lives.

* David enrolled at Harvard, where he learned the history of conservative political movements and how they were playing the long game, winning state legislatures and appointing far-right judges, to beat progressives.

* In 2022, David supported the election of Maxwell Frost, the first Gen Z member of Congress, alongside his young campaign manager Kevin Lata.

* In 2023, David and Kevin founded Leaders We Deserve, an organization dedicated to electing the next generation of progressive political leaders.

In addition to highlighting the story of Leaders We Deserve, the _Fast Company_ article also featured Anna Thomas, Allie Phillips, and Ashwin Ramaswami, just a few of our endorsed candidates who are running in state legislative races this year.
_**Fast Company**_ **called Gen Z “the most politically engaged generation we’ve ever seen”** and all of us here at Leaders We Deserve couldn’t agree more. We see it in action every day with our incredible candidates and the young people who are stepping up to do the work volunteering on these history-making campaigns.
It’s pretty awesome to get featured in a national magazine — and hopefully, the media attention brings even more fired-up supporters into our organization!
**[Our work is just getting started, Peter. We need your support to elect our inspiring slate of young people this year — and to keep our momentum going next year and beyond. Please, pitch in $5 now to back us in this fight!](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwd-em-20240724-2?refcode=em20240724-2&amount=5&refcode2=984_587540_eMAsw5&akid=984%2E587540%2EeMAsw5)**

Thank you for your support!
Leaders We Deserve
P.S. Check out [**the full article from _Fast Company_**](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/1032?t=2&akid=984%2E587540%2EeMAsw5) to see what else they had to say about Leaders We Deserve!
